- Trigger has `title="Ticket price" aria-label="Ticket price"`, `.fc-money` glyph `$`, a `.card-value.card-value--price[data-value="price"]` that starts `hidden`, and `▾`.
- Panel `#pricePanel.card-panel--mini`: `<p class="panel-title">Ticket price</p>`, `<p class="panel-hint">Cheapest ticket, up to:</p>`, then `<div class="segmented segmented--wrap" id="priceOptions" role="group" aria-label="Ticket price">`.
- Options built from `PRICE_OPTIONS` (`shared/price.js:105-109`) — `PRICE_CAPS = [10, 15, 20, 30]`:

| value | `label` (chip / aria) | `short` (segmented button) |
|---|---|---|
| `any` | `Any price` | `Any` |
| `free` | `Free` | `Free` |
| `10` | `Up to £10` | `£10` |
| `15` | `Up to £15` | `£15` |
| `20` | `Up to £20` | `£20` |
| `30` | `Up to £30` | `£30` |

- Trigger: `.fc-ico` `🚶`, `.card-value[data-value="travel"]` initial text `Walk ≤ 10 min`, caret `▾`.
- Panel `#travelPanel`: `<p class="panel-title">How are you getting there?</p>`, `#travelOptions`, `<label class="panel-field-label" for="travelRange">Max travel time</label>`, `<input type="range" id="travelRange" class="panel-range" min="1" max="60" step="1" value="10">`, `<p class="range-value" id="travelValue">10 min max</p>`.
- Radio options (`TRAVEL_MODES`, `app.js:71`): `Walking`, `Taxi/Car`, `Bicycle`. Each label reads `` `{mode} <small class="opt-speed">({speed} km/h)</small>` `` — rendered speeds **3.3**, **30**, **15** (`TRAVEL_SPEEDS_KMH` = `Walking: (5*2)/3`, `Taxi/Car: 30`, `Bicycle: 15`, `app.js:72-78`; `modeSpeedLabel` rounds to 1 dp).
- Slider: `MIN_TRAVEL_MINUTES = 1`, `MAX_TRAVEL_MINUTES = 60`, step 1, default `DEFAULT_MAX_TRAVEL = 10` (`app.js:84-86`). Fires on `input` (live).
- Labels (`updateTravelLabels`, `app.js:1789-1797`): `#travelValue` = `` `${n} min max` ``; chip = `` `${short} ≤ ${n} min` `` with `short` map `Walking → Walk`, `Taxi/Car → Taxi`, `Bicycle → Bike`, e.g. `Bike ≤ 25 min`.
- Changing mode or slider resets `showCap` to `SHOW_PAGE` and re-runs `refreshMap()`.

### 6.5 Facet-count semantics
- `facetPool(facet)` = `fittingShows(facet)` — i.e. the **reachable, not-yet-started, still-makes-your-commitment** set, with every filter applied *except* the facet's own (`app.js:414-428, 1492-1494`). So a count answers "how many would ticking this give me".
- Both ends of a checkbox panel mean "don't narrow": `genreFilterActive()` is false when the set is empty **or** all 10 are selected (`app.js:401-407`); same for subgenres against `state.subgenreOptions`.
- Counts are rewritten in place (`refreshFacetCounts`, `app.js:1691-1708`) rather than by rebuilding rows, so focus isn't dropped mid-click.

### 6.6 Panel open/close plumbing (`wirePanels`, `app.js:2404-2458`)
- Clicking a `.card-trigger` closes all panels then opens its own if it was closed (a true toggle). `stopPropagation()`.
- Click anywhere not inside `.card` closes all panels.
- `Escape` closes all panels.
- `openPanel`: removes `hidden`, runs `clampPanel`, sets `aria-expanded="true"`, adds `.is-open` to the `.card`; for `#constraintPanel` it defers `syncWheels(false)` to the next animation frame (wheels can't be positioned while `display:none`).
- `closeAllPanels`: hides all `.card-panel`, sets every trigger `aria-expanded="false"`, removes `.is-open`, clears `editingCommitment`.
- `clampPanel` (`app.js:2429-2437`): nudges a panel back inside the viewport with an 8 px pad via `transform: translateX(…)`.

## 7. View selector (`Closest | Soonest | Map`)

`index.html:316-338`, `<div class="view-row" aria-label="View">`:
- `<span class="filters-label">Show</span>`
- `<div class="view-switch" role="group" aria-label="Show closest first, soonest first, or the map">`
- Three `<button class="view-btn" data-mode="…" aria-pressed="…">` each with an inline SVG + `<span class="view-btn-label">`:
  - `data-mode="closest"` — pin SVG — label **`Closest`** — starts `.is-active`, `aria-pressed="true"`
  - `data-mode="soonest"` — clock SVG — label **`Soonest`** — `aria-pressed="false"`
  - `data-mode="map"` — folded-map SVG — label **`Map`** — `aria-pressed="false"`
- Active button: white text on `--red` background (`styles.css:1279`).

**Semantics** (`VIEW_MODES`, `applyViewMode`, `app.js:993-1049`):
| mode | `state.view` | `state.sortBy` |
|---|---|---|
| `closest` (default) | `list` | `distance` |
| `soonest` | `list` | `time` |
| `map` | `map` | *(unchanged)* |

- `applyViewMode` sets `#map.hidden = view !== "map"`, `#shows.hidden = view !== "list"`, and `.view-area[data-view]` to `list` / `map`.
- An order change resets `state.showCap = SHOW_PAGE` and re-renders the list.
- Entering map mode calls `state.map.invalidateSize()` (Leaflet can't measure a `display:none` container).
- Clicking the already-active mode is a no-op (`app.js:1044`).
- The chosen mode is persisted (`saveNowState`).

`index.html:344-358`: `<div class="view-area" data-view="list"> <div class="view-panes"> <section id="map" class="map-section" hidden> … </section> <section id="shows" class="shows-section"> <div class="shows-grid" id="showsGrid"></div> <button id="showMore" class="show-more" type="button" hidden>Show more</button> </section>`.

**8.1 Which shows** (`fittingShows`, `app.js:869-886`):
- Start from `displayedShows()` — the filtered set classified as not `hidden`.
- **Exclude** the committed show (`show.id !== state.selectedShowId`).
- If a commitment exists and the selected leg show doesn't classify `ok` against it, that show is dropped from the list too (kept on map/plan).
- **Without a commitment**, only shows starting within `NOW.minutes + 120` minutes (`app.js:883`) — "the next couple of hours".

**8.2 Classification** (`classifyShow`, `app.js:476-502`) returns `selected | ok | tight | hidden`:
- `show.id === constraint.id` → `selected`.
- `travelMinutes(here, there) > state.maxTravelMinutes` → `hidden`.

- Travel time = `distanceKm(a,b) / speed * 60` where distance is **great-circle (haversine, R = 6371 km)** — straight-line, not street routing (`app.js:440-444`, `2711-2720`).

**8.3 Sorting**
- `distance`: `a.walk - b.walk || a.show.time.localeCompare(b.show.time)`.
- `time`: `a.show.time.localeCompare(b.show.time)`.
- `walk` = `Math.max(1, Math.round(travelMinutes(user, show)))` — never below 1.

## 10. Data loading & errors

**10.1 Files fetched** (`loadShows`, `app.js:225-246`), in parallel:
- `data/venues.json` — TTL `LOOKUPS_TTL_MS = DAY_MS` (24 h). Supplies `venues`, `rooms`, `genres`, `subgenres`, `ticketStatuses`.
- `data/days/${NOW.fringeDate}.json` — TTL `DAY_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000` (**1 hour**, matching the hourly ticket refresh; rationale at `app.js:194-212`).
- `package.json` (uncached `fetch`) for the version string.

**10.2 Cache** (`shared/data-cache.js`): payloads in Cache Storage (`edfringe-data-v1`), timestamps in `localStorage["edfringe.data.fetched.v1"]` as a `url → epoch ms` map. Inside the TTL the cached body is returned with no network. On a failed refresh, a **stale cached copy wins** over an error. Degrades to plain `fetch` where Cache Storage isn't available (`file://`, plain http).

**10.3 Error surfaces — there are none.** Every failure path is console-only:
- `loadShows` catch → `console.error("Could not load show data:", err)` and `state.shows = []` (`app.js:242-245`). The user then sees the ordinary "Nothing reachable…" empty state, **not** an error message.
- `noteCache` → `console.info("Data cache —", url, err)` (`app.js:251-253`).
- Geolocation unsupported → `console.warn("Geolocation not supported; keeping default location.")`.
- Geolocation error → `console.info("Using default location:", err.message)`.
- Out-of-UK location → `console.info("Real location (…) is outside the UK — keeping the central Edinburgh default for testing.")`.
- Place search failure → `console.warn("Place search unavailable:", err)` **and** the visible `Map search isn’t reachable right now.` message (the only user-visible error string on the page).
- localStorage read/write failure → `console.info("EdFringeNow: couldn't read saved settings" / "couldn't save settings", err)`.
- Version fetch failure → `console.warn("EdFringeNow: couldn't read app version", err)`.

**10.4 Show record shape** (`adaptShow`, `app.js:262-292`):
- `id = ${entry.id}__${entry.start}__${index}` (unique per performance).
- Venue name fallback chain: `venues[code].name` → `` `Venue ${entry.venue}` `` → **`Venue TBC`**. With a room: `` `${venueName} — ${room}` `` (em dash).
- `duration = entry.duration || 60` (default 60 min).
- Shows whose venue has no lat/lng are **dropped entirely** (`app.js:239-241`).
- `price = entry.pm` when numeric, else `entry.free ? 0 : null`.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---|---|
| No `geolocation` in navigator | Keep central-Edinburgh default; debug menu stays hidden |
| Granted, position inside UK box | Move pin (`recenter: true, real: true`), popup becomes `You are here`, **and switch to the real clock** (`adoptRealClock()`); debug menu stays hidden |
| Granted, position outside UK box | Keep the default pin, keep the simulated clock, **reveal the debug menu** |
| Denied / unavailable / timed out | Keep central-Edinburgh default; debug menu stays hidden |

## 11. Time semantics

**11.1 The fringe day** (`shared/fringe-day.js`): a day runs **06:00 → 06:00**. `FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES = 360`, `FRINGE_DAY_END_MINUTES = 1800`. Times inside a day are minutes from that day's own midnight, range 360–1799; past-midnight times are ≥ 1440 and carry **extended `"HH:MM"`** strings (00:30 next morning = `"24:30"`) so string sorts/comparisons stay ordered. Only display wraps them back (`clockHHMM`, `clockLabel`, `hourLabel`).

**11.2 What "now" is** — the `NOW` object (`app.js:111-118`), initial simulated pre-set:
```
date: "2026-08-14", dateLabel: "Fri 14 Aug", time: "15:44", tz: "BST",
fringeDate: "2026-08-14", minutes: 944
```
backed by `simNowDate = festivalDate("2026-08-14T15:44")` (`app.js:124`).
- Every comparison against a show start uses `NOW.minutes`.
- The pre-set is replaced by the device clock **only** when geolocation confirms an in-UK position.

**11.3 Edinburgh wall-clock everywhere** (`js/clock.js`): `FESTIVAL_TZ = "Europe/London"`. `festivalNow(date)` reads any instant through `Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone, hourCycle: "h23", … })`, falling back to the device clock if the zone is unavailable. `festivalDate(local)` is the inverse (two correction passes to survive DST edges). `timeZoneLabel()` yields `BST`/`GMT`, returning `""` (so the previous label is kept) if the browser won't say.

**11.4 The ticker** (`startClockTicks`, `app.js:2576-2586`): only started once the real clock is adopted. Re-arms with `msToNextMinute(new Date())` (`clock.js:27-30`) so it fires **on** the minute rather than drifting; also re-syncs on `visibilitychange` when the tab becomes visible. Guarded so repeated `adoptRealClock()` calls (the header pin re-asks for location) can't stack timers.

**11.5 Tick suppression** (`syncToRealClock`, `app.js:2593-2598`): skips when nothing changed, and **skips while any `.card.is-open`** — re-rendering would repopulate the wheels out from under someone using them; the next tick catches up.

**11.6 Day rollover** (`applyNow`, `app.js:2603-2636`): reloads the per-day file **only when `NOW.fringeDate` changes** — i.e. at 06:00, **not** at midnight. Then rebuilds the genre panel, subgenre panel, constraint panel, map and list.

**11.7 Time-dependent behaviours**
- List without a commitment: only shows starting `<= NOW.minutes + 120` (2 hours).
- Wheel opens at now + 120 min, offers now → 29:55.
- `constraintShows()`: `start >= NOW.minutes`.
- Show cards do **not** render a "starts in X min" string — the card side shows the absolute start time (`.si-time`) and walk minutes (`.si-walk`). The relative-time language lives on the plan's slack chips ("… to spare", "N min late") and the spare-time prompt.
- Sold-out data freshness is bounded by the 1-hour day-file TTL.

**11.8 Plan restoration & staleness** (`adoptRestoredPlan`, `app.js:2372-2401`):
- A commitment is stale when the saved fringe date ≠ today's, **or** `isPastTime(selectedTime)` (`<= NOW.minutes`, `app.js:2366-2368`), **or** its show is no longer in today's data, **or** its show's start has passed.
- A picked leg show is stale when the day differs, or the show is gone, or it has started.
- Stale items are **dropped silently and permanently** — nothing is offered back, nothing to dismiss.
- `buildConstraintPanel` (`app.js:1898-1912`) additionally drops a `selectedTime` earlier than `earliestWheelMinutes(NOW.minutes)` **only** if nothing real (a still-present show or a non-empty destLabel) is behind it.

### 3.3 Time-wheel semantics (`js/constraint-time.js`)
- `WHEEL_STEP = 5`; `WHEEL_MINUTES = ["00","05",…,"55"]` (line 21-22).
- Hours offered: current hour → `LAST_HOUR`, where `LAST_SLOT = FRINGE_DAY_END_MINUTES - 5 = 1795` (29:55) so `LAST_HOUR = 29` (lines 25-26, 40-45). Extended hours 24–29 are **displayed** as 00–05 via `hourLabel()` (`shared/fringe-day.js:68-70`).
- `earliestWheelMinutes(now)` = next whole 5 minutes, clamped to `LAST_SLOT` (line 34-36).
- `minutesForHour(hh, now)`: full set for every hour except the current one, where already-gone minutes are dropped (lines 49-54).
- `defaultConstraintTime(now)` = now + `CONSTRAINT_DEFAULT_LEAD_MINUTES` (**120**), snapped to 5 min, clamped between earliest and last slot (lines 30, 58-63).
- Wheel item height `WHEEL_ITEM_H = 40` px (`app.js:1826`). Value read ~130 ms after scroll stops (`app.js:1927-1938`); a scroll event fired while `el.offsetParent === null` (panel closed) is ignored.
- Keyboard: `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` on a wheel move one item, smooth-scrolled, clamped (`app.js:1940-1946`).
- Wheel scroll mask: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 32%, #000 68%, transparent)` (`styles.css:1081-1082`).

### 3.4 Count + pick list states (`renderConstraintShows`, `app.js:2152-2211`)
Candidate pool `constraintShows()` = all loaded shows with `timeToMinutes(s.time) >= NOW.minutes`. **Deliberately ignores the genre/subgenre/price filters** (`app.js:436-438`).

| Condition | `#constraintCount` | `#constraintCountLab` | `#showPickList` |
|---|---|---|---|
| No future start times at all | `0` | `shows later today` | `<p class="picklist-empty">No later shows to aim for today.</p>` |
| Times exist, none at the chosen minute | count of shows at chosen time (0) | `shows start at HH:MM` | `<p class="picklist-empty">No shows start exactly then. Nearest:</p>` + `.timepick-suggest` with up to **4** buttons |
| ≥1 show at the chosen time | animated count | `show starts at HH:MM` (n=1) / `shows start at HH:MM` | one `.show-pick` button per show |

- Nearest-time suggestion buttons read `` `${clockLabel(t)} · ${count}` `` e.g. `18:30 · 7` (`app.js:2181-2184`). Click → `setConstraintTime(t)` + `syncWheels(true)`.
- `.show-pick` button markup (`app.js:2199-2209`): `.sp-radio` (custom radio; selected state `.is-sel` draws a gold dot, `styles.css:1114`), `.sp-title` = show title, `.sp-venue` = venue, `.sp-genre` = genre, and — **only when `showPrice(s) !== null`** — ` · ` + `priceLabel(s)`. Then `subgenreTags(s)`. Staggered `animation-delay: ${i*40}ms` with `.anim` class when animating.
- Count animation `tweenCount` (`app.js:2214-2233`): cubic ease-out over **380 ms**, plus a `.bump` class. Skipped entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (also `styles.css:1377-1379`).

### 3.5 Interactions in the panel
- **Tap a `.show-pick`** → `selectConstraintShow(id)` (`app.js:2136-2148`): sets it as the commitment, clears any place/note, clears `legShowId` if it was that show, resets `spareCtaDismissed=false`, resets list page cap, then `refreshMap()` and **closes all panels**.
- **Roll a wheel** → `setConstraintTime(hhmm)` (`app.js:2117-2131`): browses only. Clears `selectedShowId`, `destLabel`, `destPlace`, `destNote`, resets `spareCtaDismissed`, list cap; re-renders.
- **Type in `#destInput`** (`app.js:1958-1971`): mirrors into `state.destLabel`, enables/disables `#destFind` on non-empty trimmed value, and **invalidates** any previously found place or note.
- **Enter in `#destInput`** with non-empty value → `findPlaceOnMap()` (`app.js:1972-1977`).
- **Click `#destFind`** → `findPlaceOnMap()`.

### 3.6 Place search (geocoding) — `findPlaceOnMap`, `app.js:2000-2031`
- One search at a time (`placeSearchInFlight`).
- While in flight the button is disabled and its text becomes **`Finding…`**; restored to the previous label afterwards.
- URL: `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?` with `q`, `format=jsonv2`, `limit=5`, `addressdetails=1`, `viewbox=${minLng},${maxLat},${maxLng},${minLat}` (`places.js:66-77`). **Not** `bounded=1` — see the comment at `places.js:17-26`.
- Edinburgh box: `{ minLat: 55.87, maxLat: 56.0, minLng: -3.46, maxLng: -3.02 }` (`places.js:27`). Out-of-box hits are dropped client-side (`places.js:155`).
- Exactly one result → committed immediately (`commitPlace`), no result list.
- Otherwise → `renderPlaceResults(q, places)`.

**Result-box copy** (`app.js:2039-2069`) in `#destResults`:
| State | `.place-msg` text |
|---|---|
| Search threw / non-OK HTTP (`places === null`) | `Map search isn’t reachable right now.` |
| ≥1 hit | `Which one?` |
| 0 hits | `Couldn’t find “<q>” around Edinburgh.` (curly quotes) |

Each hit is a `<button class="place-hit" data-i="i">` with `.ph-ico` = `placeIcon(kind)`, `.ph-title` = label, and `.ph-area` = street/neighbourhood/suburb when present. A trailing row is **always** appended: `<button class="place-hit place-hit--note">` with `📝` and title `Keep “<q>” as a note`.

**Place kinds and icons** (`places.js:83-134`): `restaurant 🍽️`, `cafe ☕`, `pub 🍺`, `train 🚆`, `hotel 🛏️`, `attraction 🏛️`, `theatre 🎭`, `other 📍`. Bucketing rules: `railway` + `station|halt|stop` → train; `building`+`train_station` → train; `amenity` restaurant/food_court/biergarten → restaurant; cafe/fast_food/ice_cream → cafe; pub/bar/nightclub → pub; theatre/arts_centre → theatre; camera_obscura/planetarium → attraction; `tourism` hotel/hostel/guest_house/apartment → hotel; museum/attraction/gallery/viewpoint/zoo/theme_park → attraction; `historic` → attraction; else `other`.
**De-duplication**: same label within `NEARBY_LAT 0.004` / `NEARBY_LNG 0.006` is one place; a typed duplicate replaces a kept `other` (`places.js:141, 165-176`).

- `commitPlace` (`app.js:2083-2098`): pins it, clears `selectedShowId`, resets both dismiss flags, fills the input with the label, clears results, refreshes and closes panels.
- `commitPlaceNote` (`app.js:2103-2113`): label-only, **also clears `legShowId`** (no coordinates ⇒ can't judge fit), no pin, no route.

## 4. Plan strip (`#journeyStrip`)

`index.html:225`: `<section id="journeyStrip" class="plan" aria-label="Your plan"></section>`. Fully rendered by `renderJourneyStrip()` (`app.js:1080-1189`).

**4.1 Empty condition**: if there's no commitment, no selected leg show and no `destNote`, `strip.innerHTML = ""` (`app.js:1095-1098`).

**4.2 Header row** (`app.js:1102-1110`): `.plan-head-row` with `<p class="plan-head">Your plan</p>` and — **only when a commitment exists** — `<a id="mapsRouteLink" class="plan-maps-mild" href="…" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open this route in Google Maps">` = inline Google Maps 4-colour pin SVG + text ` Open in Maps`.

**4.3 Origin node**: `planNode("📍", "you", "${NOW.time} · now", "You are here", state.travelMode.toLowerCase(), …)` — e.g. time `15:44 · now`, sub `walking` / `taxi/car` / `bicycle` (`app.js:1111`).

**4.4 Legs** (`planLeg`, `app.js:1415-1417`): `<div class="plan-leg">{glyph} {N} min {verb}</div>`.
- Glyphs: `Walking 🚶`, `Taxi/Car 🚕`, `Bicycle 🚲` (`app.js:848`).
- Verbs: `Walking → walk`, `Taxi/Car → by taxi`, `Bicycle → by bike` (`app.js:855`).
- Minutes = `Math.max(1, Math.round(mins))` — never below 1 (`formatMins`, `app.js:1462-1464`).
- Note leg (label-only place): `<div class="plan-leg">{glyph} make your own way</div>` (`app.js:1422-1424`).

**4.5 Stop node** (selected show): `planNode(genreIcon, "stop", "HH:MM–HH:MM", title, "${venue} · ${genre}", slack, subgenreTags + planBuy)` (`app.js:1122-1133`). Time range = `clockLabel(start)` – `minutesToTime(start + duration)`.

**4.6 Slack chip** (`planSlack`, `app.js:1454-1459`):
- `m >= 0` → `<span class="plan-slack ok">{friendlyDuration(m)} to spare</span>`
- `m < 0` → `<span class="plan-slack late">{-m} min late</span>`
- When the selected show would break the commitment, the stop instead shows `<span class="plan-slack wontfit">You'll be late</span>` (`app.js:1130`), coloured white-on-`#e5484d` (`styles.css:1214`).
- `friendlyDuration` bands (`shared/duration.js:44-65`): `< 60` → `"45 minutes"`; `60–120` → `"1 hour and 20 minutes"` (exactly 60/120 → `"1 hour"` / `"2 hours"`); `> 120` → `"about 2½ hours"` (rounded to nearest half hour). Negative/non-finite → `""`.

**4.7 Destination node** (`destNode`, `app.js:1363-1367`): icon = genre icon for a show or `placeIcon(kind)` for a place; time `clockLabel(constraint.time)`; title = `destinationLabel()`; sub = **`Your next commitment`**; extra = partner link for a place.
- Note-only destination (`noteDestNode`, `app.js:1426-1428`): icon `📝`, title = the note text, sub `Your next commitment`, no slack.

**4.8 Node controls** (`wireNodeControls`, `app.js:1194-1211`) added to `.plan-node.stop` and `.plan-node.dest`; node gets class `has-node-controls`:
- `<button class="chg-link" data-act="change">Change ▾</button>` and `<button class="chg-x" data-act="remove">×</button>`.
- Stop: `aria-label="Pick a different show"` / `"Remove selected show"`. Change → smooth-scrolls `#shows` into view (`block: "start"`); Remove → clears `legShowId` and refreshes.
- Dest: `aria-label="Change your next commitment"` / `"Remove your next commitment"`. Change → `openConstraintEditor()` (reopens `#constraintPanel`, sets `editingCommitment`, smooth-scrolls it to `block: "center"`, `app.js:640-649`); Remove → `clearCommitment()` (`app.js:654-667`) which clears time/show/label/place/note and both dismiss flags but **keeps** the selected show.
- Both handlers `stopPropagation()`.

**4.9 Spare-time prompt** (`spareCtaNode`, `app.js:1307-1320`) — occupies the plan's middle slot when a commitment exists and no show is slipped in.
- Rendered only when: not dismissed, `planSpareMinutes()` is non-null and `> 0`, and `fittingShows().length > 0`. Otherwise the slot falls back to a plain `planLeg`.
- Markup: `.plan-spare` with dismiss `<button class="plan-spare-x" aria-label="Dismiss — hide this suggestion" title="Dismiss">×</button>` and
  `<p class="spare-line">You have <b>{friendlyDuration(spare)}</b> to spare — want to see a show? <a class="spare-count spare-jump" href="#shows">{n} {fits|fit} below</a></p>`
  ("fits" when n === 1, "fit" otherwise).
- Clicking the link `preventDefault()`s and smooth-scrolls `#shows` into view (`app.js:1333-1340`).
- `planSpareMinutes()` (`app.js:1277-1298`): with a fitting leg, arrival = leg start + leg duration + travel(leg→dest); otherwise arrival = `NOW.minutes` + travel(you→dest). Spare = `round(constraint start − arrival)`.

**4.10 Booking question for a committed place** (`planPartnerLink`, `app.js:1376-1399`):
- Rendered only if `partnerLink()` returns non-null (i.e. kinds `theatre` and `other` get nothing — `places.js:259`).
- Date/time passed to the partner is the **real** calendar moment via `realMoment(NOW.fringeDate, state.selectedTime)`, not the fringe-extended time (`app.js:1381-1383`).
- Undismissed: `<div class="plan-book-cta">` + `<button class="plan-book-x" aria-label="Dismiss — hide the booking question" title="Dismiss">×</button>` + `<p class="book-q">Need to book it?</p>` + the big anchor `.plan-book-btn`.
- Dismissed: just the quiet pill `.plan-buy-inline` (the link survives; the question doesn't).
- Anchor label: `` `${placeIcon(kind)} ${link.text} · ${link.partner}` ``; `target="_blank" rel="noopener sponsored"`; `title="Opens {partner} — booking via this link supports EdFringeNow"`.

**Partner link URL patterns** (`places.js:219-260`):
| Kind | text · partner | URL |
|---|---|---|
| restaurant / cafe / pub | `Book a table` · `OpenTable` | `https://www.opentable.co.uk/s?term={label}&latitude={lat}&longitude={lng}` + (when time known) `&covers=2&dateTime={ISO}T{HH:MM}` + (if `opentableRef`) `&ref=…` |
| train | `Train times & tickets` · `Trainline` | `https://www.thetrainline.com/stations/{slug}` when the lowercased label is in `TRAINLINE_STATION_SLUGS` (`{"edinburgh waverley": "edinburgh"}`), else `https://www.thetrainline.com/`; wrapped in `https://prf.hn/click/camref:{camref}/destination:{url}` when `trainlineCamref` set |
| hotel | `Check availability` · `Booking.com` | `https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss={label}, Edinburgh` + `&checkin={date}&checkout={nextDay}`; wrapped in `https://www.awin1.com/cread.php?awinmid=…&awinaffid=…&ued=…` when both Awin IDs set |
| attraction | `Book tickets & tours` · `GetYourGuide` | `https://www.getyourguide.com/s/?q={label} Edinburgh` + (if `gygPartnerId`) `&partner_id=…` |
| theatre / other | — | `null` (no link rendered) |

All `AFFILIATES` IDs in `places.js:55-61` are currently **empty strings** → every link ships untagged.

**4.11 Show buy-ahead link** (`planBuy`, `app.js:1441-1449`), on the stop node:
- `show.free` → `""` (nothing rendered).
- `show.available === false` → `<span class="plan-soldout">Sold out</span>` (note: sentence case, distinct from the card stamp).
- Otherwise → `<a class="plan-buy-inline" href="{ticketUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Buy ahead on edfringe.com — skips the box-office queue (~5 min)">🎟 Buy ahead · skip the queue</a>` (`&#127915;` = 🎟).
- `ticketUrl(show)` = `https://www.edfringe.com/tickets/whats-on/{encodeURIComponent(show.slug)}`, or `""` → href falls back to `#` (`app.js:1432-1436, 1445`).

**4.12 Google Maps route URL** (`googleMapsUrl`, `app.js:1230-1263`):
- 0 stops → `https://www.google.com/maps/@{lat},{lng},15z`
- ≥1 stop → `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin={lat,lng}&destination={lat,lng}&travelmode={mode}` plus `&waypoints={lat,lng|…}` when a leg show precedes the destination.
- `travelmode`: `Walking → walking`, `Taxi/Car → driving`, `Bicycle → bicycling` (`app.js:1214-1219`).

Each label reads `` `{mode} <small class="opt-speed">({speed} km/h)</small>` `` — rendered speeds **3.3**, **30**, **15** (`TRAVEL_SPEEDS_KMH` = `Walking: (5*2)/3`, `Taxi/Car: 30`, `Bicycle: 15`, `app.js:72-78`; `modeSpeedLabel` rounds to 1 dp).

- Labels (`updateTravelLabels`, `app.js:1789-1797`): `#travelValue` = `` `${n} min max` ``; chip = `` `${short} ≤ ${n} min` `` with `short` map `Walking → Walk`, `Taxi/Car → Taxi`, `Bicycle → Bike`, e.g. `Bike ≤ 25 min`.

### 6.5 Facet-count semantics
- `facetPool(facet)` = `fittingShows(facet)` — i.e. the **reachable, not-yet-started, still-makes-your-commitment** set, with every filter applied *except* the facet's own (`app.js:414-428, 1492-1494`). So a count answers "how many would ticking this give me".
- Both ends of a checkbox panel mean "don't narrow": `genreFilterActive()` is false when the set is empty **or** all 10 are selected (`app.js:401-407`); same for subgenres against `state.subgenreOptions`.
- Counts are rewritten in place (`refreshFacetCounts`, `app.js:1691-1708`) rather than by rebuilding rows, so focus isn't dropped mid-click.

### 6.6 Panel open/close plumbing (`wirePanels`, `app.js:2404-2458`)
- Clicking a `.card-trigger` closes all panels then opens its own if it was closed (a true toggle). `stopPropagation()`.
- Click anywhere not inside `.card` closes all panels.
- `Escape` closes all panels.
- `openPanel`: removes `hidden`, runs `clampPanel`, sets `aria-expanded="true"`, adds `.is-open` to the `.card`; for `#constraintPanel` it defers `syncWheels(false)` to the next animation frame (wheels can't be positioned while `display:none`).
- `closeAllPanels`: hides all `.card-panel`, sets every trigger `aria-expanded="false"`, removes `.is-open`, clears `editingCommitment`.
- `clampPanel` (`app.js:2429-2437`): nudges a panel back inside the viewport with an 8 px pad via `transform: translateX(…)`.

## 8. Show list & cards

`index.html:344-358`: `<div class="view-area" data-view="list"> <div class="view-panes"> <section id="map" class="map-section" hidden> … </section> <section id="shows" class="shows-section"> <div class="shows-grid" id="showsGrid"></div> <button id="showMore" class="show-more" type="button" hidden>Show more</button> </section>`.

**8.1 Which shows** (`fittingShows`, `app.js:869-886`):
- Start from `displayedShows()` — the filtered set classified as not `hidden`.
- **Exclude** the committed show (`show.id !== state.selectedShowId`).
- If a commitment exists and the selected leg show doesn't classify `ok` against it, that show is dropped from the list too (kept on map/plan).
- **Without a commitment**, only shows starting within `NOW.minutes + 120` minutes (`app.js:883`) — "the next couple of hours".

**8.2 Classification** (`classifyShow`, `app.js:476-502`) returns `selected | ok | tight | hidden`:
- `show.id === constraint.id` → `selected`.
- `travelMinutes(here, there) > state.maxTravelMinutes` → `hidden`.
- `arrival = NOW.minutes + travel`; `reachInTime = arrival <= start`; `tight = !reachInTime && (arrival - start) <= GRACE_MINUTES` (**GRACE_MINUTES = 5**, `app.js:87`).
- With a commitment: also require `start + show.duration + travel(show → constraint) <= constraint start`, else `hidden`; and then only `reachInTime` survives (a tight show is `hidden` once committed).
- Without a commitment: `ok` / `tight` / `hidden`.
- Travel time = `distanceKm(a,b) / speed * 60` where distance is **great-circle (haversine, R = 6371 km)** — straight-line, not street routing (`app.js:440-444`, `2711-2720`).

**8.3 Sorting**
- `distance`: `a.walk - b.walk || a.show.time.localeCompare(b.show.time)`.
- `time`: `a.show.time.localeCompare(b.show.time)`.
- `walk` = `Math.max(1, Math.round(travelMinutes(user, show)))` — never below 1.
- **Time sorting inserts group headings**: `<h3 class="shows-group-head">{clockLabel(show.time)}</h3>` per distinct start time (`app.js:932-938`). Distance sorting produces a flat list with no headings.

**8.4 Card markup** (`app.js:939-955`): `<article class="show-item show-item--{status}{ show-item--soldout}" tabindex="0" role="button">` containing:
- `showStamp(show, status)` (see 8.5)
- `.si-main`: `.show-genre` (genre, uppercase small red caps), `.show-name` (title, serif, ellipsised), `.show-meta` (venue), `subgenreTags(show)`
- `.si-side`: `.si-time` = `clockLabel(show.time)`, `<br>`, `.si-walk` = `` `🚶 ${walk} min · ${show.price}` ``, and **only when a commitment exists** `<br><span class="si-fits">fits</span>`

**8.5 Stamps** (`showStamp`, `app.js:2742-2746`) — diagonal ink stamps, `pointer-events: none`, `rotate(-7deg)`, Alfa Slab One, `text-transform: uppercase`, roughened by SVG filter `#stamp-ink` and a fractal-noise mask (`styles.css:1330-1356`; the filter is defined at `index.html:35-41`):
- `!show.available` → `<span class="show-stamp show-stamp--soldout">Sold out!</span>` (colour `#e2726b`) — **renders as "SOLD OUT!"**
- else `status === "tight"` → `<span class="show-stamp show-stamp--late">Too late!</span>` (colour `#d09a5b`) — **renders as "TOO LATE!"**
- else nothing. Both are display-only; the card stays clickable/selectable. On a `.show-item--selected` row the stamp fades to opacity 0.5.

**8.6 Availability rule** (`app.js:290, 296`): `available = !NO_TICKETS_STATUSES.has(ticketStatus)` where `NO_TICKETS_STATUSES = new Set(["SOLD_OUT", "NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE"])`. Everything else — including **unknown/null** — counts as available. The dataset's `ticketStatuses` vocabulary is `EVENT_SPECIFIC`, `FREE_NON_TICKETED`, `FREE_TICKETED`, `NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE`, `PREVIEW_SHOW`, `TICKETS_AVAILABLE`, `TWO_FOR_ONE` (note: literal `SOLD_OUT` is in the guard set but **not** in the current lookup list). The separate `soldOut` boolean flag is explicitly **not** trusted (`app.js:288-289, 1443`).

**8.7 Card state classes** (`styles.css:1314-1324`): `.show-item--tight` opacity 0.6; `.show-item--soldout` opacity 0.6; `.show-item--leg` 2px `--ok` border; `.show-item--selected` 2px `--red` border.

**8.8 Card interaction** (`app.js:956-971`): click, or `Enter`/`Space` keydown (with `preventDefault`), runs `onShowClick(show)`; if the show became the selected one, the page **smooth-scrolls to `top: 0`** (all the way up, not just to the plan). `onShowClick` (`app.js:751-755`): no-op if the show is the committed destination; otherwise toggles `state.legShowId` (clicking the same show again deselects it), then `refreshMap()`.

**8.9 Subgenre tags** (`subgenreTags`, `app.js:2731-2737`): `<span class="show-subs">` with one `<span class="show-sub">` per subgenre; returns `""` for shows with none (~2% per the comment) so the row is dropped.

**8.10 Empty states** (`app.js:914-923), rendered into `#showsGrid` as a `<p class="show-meta">`:
- **With** a commitment: `Nothing fits before your next commitment — try a later time or a wider travel window.`
- **Without**: `Nothing reachable in the next couple of hours — widen your travel window or taste.`
- `#showMore` is hidden in both cases.

**8.11 Pagination** — `SHOW_PAGE = 12` (`app.js:863`).
- `#showMore` label is rewritten to `` `Show ${Math.min(SHOW_PAGE, remaining)} more · ${remaining} left` `` e.g. `Show 12 more · 47 left` (`app.js:978`). Hidden when `remaining <= 0`.
- Click adds another `SHOW_PAGE` to `state.showCap` and re-renders (`app.js:2547-2553` — note it is wired inside `wireDebugControls`).
- The cap resets to 12 on: any taste-filter change, travel mode/slider change, view-order change, committing a show or place, and changing the constraint time.

## 10. Data loading & errors

**10.1 Files fetched** (`loadShows`, `app.js:225-246`), in parallel:
- `data/venues.json` — TTL `LOOKUPS_TTL_MS = DAY_MS` (24 h). Supplies `venues`, `rooms`, `genres`, `subgenres`, `ticketStatuses`.
- `data/days/${NOW.fringeDate}.json` — TTL `DAY_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000` (**1 hour**, matching the hourly ticket refresh; rationale at `app.js:194-212`).
- `package.json` (uncached `fetch`) for the version string.

**10.2 Cache** (`shared/data-cache.js`): payloads in Cache Storage (`edfringe-data-v1`), timestamps in `localStorage["edfringe.data.fetched.v1"]` as a `url → epoch ms` map. Inside the TTL the cached body is returned with no network. On a failed refresh, a **stale cached copy wins** over an error. Degrades to plain `fetch` where Cache Storage isn't available (`file://`, plain http).

**10.3 Error surfaces — there are none.** Every failure path is console-only:
- `loadShows` catch → `console.error("Could not load show data:", err)` and `state.shows = []` (`app.js:242-245`). The user then sees the ordinary "Nothing reachable…" empty state, **not** an error message.
- `noteCache` → `console.info("Data cache —", url, err)` (`app.js:251-253`).
- Geolocation unsupported → `console.warn("Geolocation not supported; keeping default location.")`.
- Geolocation error → `console.info("Using default location:", err.message)`.
- Out-of-UK location → `console.info("Real location (…) is outside the UK — keeping the central Edinburgh default for testing.")`.
- Place search failure → `console.warn("Place search unavailable:", err)` **and** the visible `Map search isn’t reachable right now.` message (the only user-visible error string on the page).
- localStorage read/write failure → `console.info("EdFringeNow: couldn't read saved settings" / "couldn't save settings", err)`.
- Version fetch failure → `console.warn("EdFringeNow: couldn't read app version", err)`.

**10.4 Show record shape** (`adaptShow`, `app.js:262-292`):
- `id = ${entry.id}__${entry.start}__${index}` (unique per performance).
- Venue name fallback chain: `venues[code].name` → `` `Venue ${entry.venue}` `` → **`Venue TBC`**. With a room: `` `${venueName} — ${room}` `` (em dash).
- `duration = entry.duration || 60` (default 60 min).
- Shows whose venue has no lat/lng are **dropped entirely** (`app.js:239-241`).
- `price = entry.pm` when numeric, else `entry.free ? 0 : null`.

**10.5 Geolocation flow** (`requestUserLocation`, `app.js:341-372`): options `{ enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 60000 }`.
| Outcome | Effect |
|---|---|
| No `geolocation` in navigator | Keep central-Edinburgh default; debug menu stays hidden |
| Granted, position inside UK box | Move pin (`recenter: true, real: true`), popup becomes `You are here`, **and switch to the real clock** (`adoptRealClock()`); debug menu stays hidden |
| Granted, position outside UK box | Keep the default pin, keep the simulated clock, **reveal the debug menu** |
| Denied / unavailable / timed out | Keep central-Edinburgh default; debug menu stays hidden |

## 11. Time semantics

**11.1 The fringe day** (`shared/fringe-day.js`): a day runs **06:00 → 06:00**. `FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES = 360`, `FRINGE_DAY_END_MINUTES = 1800`. Times inside a day are minutes from that day's own midnight, range 360–1799; past-midnight times are ≥ 1440 and carry **extended `"HH:MM"`** strings (00:30 next morning = `"24:30"`) so string sorts/comparisons stay ordered. Only display wraps them back (`clockHHMM`, `clockLabel`, `hourLabel`).

**11.2 What "now" is** — the `NOW` object (`app.js:111-118`), initial simulated pre-set:
```
date: "2026-08-14", dateLabel: "Fri 14 Aug", time: "15:44", tz: "BST",
fringeDate: "2026-08-14", minutes: 944
```
backed by `simNowDate = festivalDate("2026-08-14T15:44")` (`app.js:124`).
- Every comparison against a show start uses `NOW.minutes`.
- The pre-set is replaced by the device clock **only** when geolocation confirms an in-UK position.

Re-arms with `msToNextMinute(new Date())` (`clock.js:27-30`) so it fires **on** the minute rather than drifting; also re-syncs on `visibilitychange` when the tab becomes visible. - List without a commitment: only shows starting `<= NOW.minutes + 120` (2 hours).

- Show cards do **not** render a "starts in X min" string — the card side shows the absolute start time (`.si-time`) and walk minutes (`.si-walk`). The relative-time language lives on the plan's slack chips ("… to spare", "N min late") and the spare-time prompt.

**11.8 Plan restoration & staleness** (`adoptRestoredPlan`, `app.js:2372-2401`):
- A commitment is stale when the saved fringe date ≠ today's, **or** `isPastTime(selectedTime)` (`<= NOW.minutes`, `app.js:2366-2368`), **or** its show is no longer in today's data, **or** its show's start has passed.

`index.html:225`: `<section id="journeyStrip" class="plan" aria-label="Your plan"></section>`. Fully rendered by `renderJourneyStrip()` (`app.js:1080-1189`).

**4.1 Empty condition**: if there's no commitment, no selected leg show and no `destNote`, `strip.innerHTML = ""` (`app.js:1095-1098`).

**4.2 Header row** (`app.js:1102-1110`): `.plan-head-row` with `<p class="plan-head">Your plan</p>` and — **only when a commitment exists** — `<a id="mapsRouteLink" class="plan-maps-mild" href="…" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open this route in Google Maps">` = inline Google Maps 4-colour pin SVG + text ` Open in Maps`.

**4.3 Origin node**: `planNode("📍", "you", "${NOW.time} · now", "You are here", state.travelMode.toLowerCase(), …)` — e.g. time `15:44 · now`, sub `walking` / `taxi/car` / `bicycle` (`app.js:1111`).

**4.4 Legs** (`planLeg`, `app.js:1415-1417`): `<div class="plan-leg">{glyph} {N} min {verb}</div>`.
- Glyphs: `Walking 🚶`, `Taxi/Car 🚕`, `Bicycle 🚲` (`app.js:848`).
- Verbs: `Walking → walk`, `Taxi/Car → by taxi`, `Bicycle → by bike` (`app.js:855`).
- Minutes = `Math.max(1, Math.round(mins))` — never below 1 (`formatMins`, `app.js:1462-1464`).
- Note leg (label-only place): `<div class="plan-leg">{glyph} make your own way</div>` (`app.js:1422-1424`).

**4.5 Stop node** (selected show): `planNode(genreIcon, "stop", "HH:MM–HH:MM", title, "${venue} · ${genre}", slack, subgenreTags + planBuy)` (`app.js:1122-1133`). Time range = `clockLabel(start)` – `minutesToTime(start + duration)`.

**4.6 Slack chip** (`planSlack`, `app.js:1454-1459`):
- `m >= 0` → `<span class="plan-slack ok">{friendlyDuration(m)} to spare</span>`
- `m < 0` → `<span class="plan-slack late">{-m} min late</span>`
- When the selected show would break the commitment, the stop instead shows `<span class="plan-slack wontfit">You'll be late</span>` (`app.js:1130`), coloured white-on-`#e5484d` (`styles.css:1214`).
- `friendlyDuration` bands (`shared/duration.js:44-65`): `< 60` → `"45 minutes"`; `60–120` → `"1 hour and 20 minutes"` (exactly 60/120 → `"1 hour"` / `"2 hours"`); `> 120` → `"about 2½ hours"` (rounded to nearest half hour). Negative/non-finite → `""`.

**4.7 Destination node** (`destNode`, `app.js:1363-1367`): icon = genre icon for a show or `placeIcon(kind)` for a place; time `clockLabel(constraint.time)`; title = `destinationLabel()`; sub = **`Your next commitment`**; extra = partner link for a place.
- Note-only destination (`noteDestNode`, `app.js:1426-1428`): icon `📝`, title = the note text, sub `Your next commitment`, no slack.

**4.8 Node controls** (`wireNodeControls`, `app.js:1194-1211`) added to `.plan-node.stop` and `.plan-node.dest`; node gets class `has-node-controls`:
- `<button class="chg-link" data-act="change">Change ▾</button>` and `<button class="chg-x" data-act="remove">×</button>`.
- Stop: `aria-label="Pick a different show"` / `"Remove selected show"`. Change → smooth-scrolls `#shows` into view (`block: "start"`); Remove → clears `legShowId` and refreshes.
- Dest: `aria-label="Change your next commitment"` / `"Remove your next commitment"`. Change → `openConstraintEditor()` (reopens `#constraintPanel`, sets `editingCommitment`, smooth-scrolls it to `block: "center"`, `app.js:640-649`); Remove → `clearCommitment()` (`app.js:654-667`) which clears time/show/label/place/note and both dismiss flags but **keeps** the selected show.
- Both handlers `stopPropagation()`.

**4.9 Spare-time prompt** (`spareCtaNode`, `app.js:1307-1320`) — occupies the plan's middle slot when a commitment exists and no show is slipped in.
- Rendered only when: not dismissed, `planSpareMinutes()` is non-null and `> 0`, and `fittingShows().length > 0`. Otherwise the slot falls back to a plain `planLeg`.
- Markup: `.plan-spare` with dismiss `<button class="plan-spare-x" aria-label="Dismiss — hide this suggestion" title="Dismiss">×</button>` and
  `<p class="spare-line">You have <b>{friendlyDuration(spare)}</b> to spare — want to see a show? <a class="spare-count spare-jump" href="#shows">{n} {fits|fit} below</a></p>`
  ("fits" when n === 1, "fit" otherwise).
- Clicking the link `preventDefault()`s and smooth-scrolls `#shows` into view (`app.js:1333-1340`).
- `planSpareMinutes()` (`app.js:1277-1298`): with a fitting leg, arrival = leg start + leg duration + travel(leg→dest); otherwise arrival = `NOW.minutes` + travel(you→dest). Spare = `round(constraint start − arrival)`.

**4.10 Booking question for a committed place** (`planPartnerLink`, `app.js:1376-1399`):
- Rendered only if `partnerLink()` returns non-null (i.e. kinds `theatre` and `other` get nothing — `places.js:259`).
- Date/time passed to the partner is the **real** calendar moment via `realMoment(NOW.fringeDate, state.selectedTime)`, not the fringe-extended time (`app.js:1381-1383`).
- Undismissed: `<div class="plan-book-cta">` + `<button class="plan-book-x" aria-label="Dismiss — hide the booking question" title="Dismiss">×</button>` + `<p class="book-q">Need to book it?</p>` + the big anchor `.plan-book-btn`.
- Dismissed: just the quiet pill `.plan-buy-inline` (the link survives; the question doesn't).
- Anchor label: `` `${placeIcon(kind)} ${link.text} · ${link.partner}` ``; `target="_blank" rel="noopener sponsored"`; `title="Opens {partner} — booking via this link supports EdFringeNow"`.

**Partner link URL patterns** (`places.js:219-260`):
| Kind | text · partner | URL |
|---|---|---|
| restaurant / cafe / pub | `Book a table` · `OpenTable` | `https://www.opentable.co.uk/s?term={label}&latitude={lat}&longitude={lng}` + (when time known) `&covers=2&dateTime={ISO}T{HH:MM}` + (if `opentableRef`) `&ref=…` |

**4.11 Show buy-ahead link** (`planBuy`, `app.js:1441-1449`), on the stop node:

## 6. Controls: filters row

`index.html:236-309`, `<div class="filters-row" aria-label="Filters">` starting with `<span class="filters-label">Filter</span>` (uppercase small-caps, `styles.css:1141`). Four chips, each an `.filter-chip.card` with a `.card-trigger` button and a `.card-panel[role="menu"][hidden]`.

### 6.1 Genre chip — `data-card="genre"`
- Trigger: `.fc-ico` (initially `🎭`), `.card-value[data-value="genre"]` (**initial markup text: `Comedy`**), `.fc-caret` `▾`.
- Panel `#genrePanel`: `<p class="panel-title panel-title--row"><span>Which genres?</span><button class="panel-everything" id="filterReset">everything!</button></p>` + `<div class="panel-options panel-options--scroll" id="genreOptions">`.
- Options (`GENRES`, `app.js:55-66`, fixed order): `Cabaret and Variety`, `Children's Shows`, `Comedy`, `Dance, Physical Theatre & Circus`, `Events`, `Exhibitions`, `Music`, `Musicals and Opera`, `Spoken Word`, `Theatre`.
- Genre emoji (`GENRE_ICONS`, `app.js:541-552`): 🎩 / 🧸 / 😄 / 💃 / 🎟️ / 🖼️ / 🎵 / 🎼 / 🗣️ / 🎭; fallback `🎭`.
- Genre colours (`genreColor`, `app.js:374-388`) exist but are not applied to any rendered element in this page's current code path.
- Each option row `facetOption` (`app.js:1474-1484`): checkbox + emoji + label + grey `<span class="opt-count" aria-label="{n} show(s)">{n}</span>`. Row gets `.is-empty` (opacity 0.55, `styles.css:365`) when count is 0.
- **Chip label** (`updateGenreValue`, `app.js:1726-1741`): 0 selected or all 10 selected → `All genres`; exactly 1 → that genre's name; otherwise → `` `${n} genres` ``. The chip icon mirrors the single genre or falls back to `🎭`.
- **`everything!` / `nothing!` link** (`app.js:1526-1535`, `1543-1554`): text is `nothing!` (title `Untick every option`) when all are ticked, else `everything!` (title `Tick every option`). Clicking selects all, or — if all are already selected — clears all.

### 6.2 Subgenre chip — `data-card="subgenre"`
- Trigger: `.fc-ico` `🏷️`, `.card-value[data-value="subgenre"]` initial text `All subgenres`, caret `▾`.
- Panel `#subgenrePanel`: heading `<span>Which subgenres?</span>` + `<button class="panel-everything" id="subgenreReset">everything!</button>` + `#subgenreOptions`.
- Options are **dynamic** (`buildSubgenrePanel`, `app.js:1578-1614`): only subgenres present in the pool the other filters leave standing, plus anything already ticked, sorted with `localeCompare`. No emoji.
- **Empty state**: `<p class="panel-note">No subgenres in what's left — widen your genres.</p>` (`app.js:1586`).
- **Chip label** (`updateSubgenreValue`, `app.js:1712-1722`): 0 selected or all currently-offered ticked → `All subgenres`; exactly 1 → that subgenre name; else `` `${n} subgenres` ``.
- Full subgenre vocabulary (from `data/venues.json`, 100+ values): `A cappella`, `Absurdist`, `Acoustic`, … `Work in Progress`, `Workshop`, `World music`, `d/Deaf-led`.

### 6.3 Price chip — `data-card="price"`, `.filter-chip--mini`
- Trigger has `title="Ticket price" aria-label="Ticket price"`, `.fc-money` glyph `$`, a `.card-value.card-value--price[data-value="price"]` that starts `hidden`, and `▾`.
- Panel `#pricePanel.card-panel--mini`: `<p class="panel-title">Ticket price</p>`, `<p class="panel-hint">Cheapest ticket, up to:</p>`, then `<div class="segmented segmented--wrap" id="priceOptions" role="group" aria-label="Ticket price">`.
- Options built from `PRICE_OPTIONS` (`shared/price.js:105-109`) — `PRICE_CAPS = [10, 15, 20, 30]`:

| value | `label` (chip / aria) | `short` (segmented button) |
|---|---|---|
| `any` | `Any price` | `Any` |
| `free` | `Free` | `Free` |
| `10` | `Up to £10` | `£10` |
| `15` | `Up to £15` | `£15` |
| `20` | `Up to £20` | `£20` |
| `30` | `Up to £30` | `£30` |

- Each `.seg-btn` carries a `<span class="seg-count">` with the reachable-show count; `.seg-count:empty { display: none; }` (`styles.css:350`). Each gets `aria-label="{label} — {n} show(s)"` (`app.js:1647-1648`) and `aria-pressed`.
- **Chip state** (`updatePriceButtons`, `app.js:1655-1670`): while `priceFilter === "any"`, the value span is `hidden` and the chip shows just `$` (muted). Once narrowed, the chip gains `.is-set` (the `$` turns red, `styles.css:1173`) and the value span shows the full `label`, e.g. `$ Up to £15`.
- **Matching rule** (`matchesPrice`, `shared/price.js:118-125`): `any` → always true. Otherwise unknown price (`priceMin` null and not free) → **false** for every choice. `free` → `price === 0`. A cap → `price <= cap` (**inclusive**).
- **`showPrice`** (`price.js:36-42`) reads `priceMin` when finite, else `free ? 0 : null`.
- **Price label on a card** (`priceLabel`, `price.js:69-75`): `null → "Price TBC"`; `0 → "Free"`; range `£12–£18` only when `max > min`; else `£12`. `formatPounds` drops `.00` for whole pounds.

### 6.4 Travel chip — `data-card="travel"`
- Trigger: `.fc-ico` `🚶`, `.card-value[data-value="travel"]` initial text `Walk ≤ 10 min`, caret `▾`.
- Panel `#travelPanel`: `<p class="panel-title">How are you getting there?</p>`, `#travelOptions`, `<label class="panel-field-label" for="travelRange">Max travel time</label>`, `<input type="range" id="travelRange" class="panel-range" min="1" max="60" step="1" value="10">`, `<p class="range-value" id="travelValue">10 min max</p>`.
- Radio options (`TRAVEL_MODES`, `app.js:71`): `Walking`, `Taxi/Car`, `Bicycle`. Each label reads `` `{mode} <small class="opt-speed">({speed} km/h)</small>` `` — rendered speeds **3.3**, **30**, **15** (`TRAVEL_SPEEDS_KMH` = `Walking: (5*2)/3`, `Taxi/Car: 30`, `Bicycle: 15`, `app.js:72-78`; `modeSpeedLabel` rounds to 1 dp).
- Slider: `MIN_TRAVEL_MINUTES = 1`, `MAX_TRAVEL_MINUTES = 60`, step 1, default `DEFAULT_MAX_TRAVEL = 10` (`app.js:84-86`). Fires on `input` (live).
- Labels (`updateTravelLabels`, `app.js:1789-1797`): `#travelValue` = `` `${n} min max` ``; chip = `` `${short} ≤ ${n} min` `` with `short` map `Walking → Walk`, `Taxi/Car → Taxi`, `Bicycle → Bike`, e.g. `Bike ≤ 25 min`.
- Changing mode or slider resets `showCap` to `SHOW_PAGE` and re-runs `refreshMap()`.

### 6.5 Facet-count semantics
- `facetPool(facet)` = `fittingShows(facet)` — i.e. the **reachable, not-yet-started, still-makes-your-commitment** set, with every filter applied *except* the facet's own (`app.js:414-428, 1492-1494`). So a count answers "how many would ticking this give me".
- Both ends of a checkbox panel mean "don't narrow": `genreFilterActive()` is false when the set is empty **or** all 10 are selected (`app.js:401-407`); same for subgenres against `state.subgenreOptions`.
- Counts are rewritten in place (`refreshFacetCounts`, `app.js:1691-1708`) rather than by rebuilding rows, so focus isn't dropped mid-click.

### 6.6 Panel open/close plumbing (`wirePanels`, `app.js:2404-2458`)
- Clicking a `.card-trigger` closes all panels then opens its own if it was closed (a true toggle). `stopPropagation()`.
- Click anywhere not inside `.card` closes all panels.
- `Escape` closes all panels.
- `openPanel`: removes `hidden`, runs `clampPanel`, sets `aria-expanded="true"`, adds `.is-open` to the `.card`; for `#constraintPanel` it defers `syncWheels(false)` to the next animation frame (wheels can't be positioned while `display:none`).
- `closeAllPanels`: hides all `.card-panel`, sets every trigger `aria-expanded="false"`, removes `.is-open`, clears `editingCommitment`.
- `clampPanel` (`app.js:2429-2437`): nudges a panel back inside the viewport with an 8 px pad via `transform: translateX(…)`.

## 7. View selector (`Closest | Soonest | Map`)

`index.html:316-338`, `<div class="view-row" aria-label="View">`:
- `<span class="filters-label">Show</span>`
- `<div class="view-switch" role="group" aria-label="Show closest first, soonest first, or the map">`
- Three `<button class="view-btn" data-mode="…" aria-pressed="…">` each with an inline SVG + `<span class="view-btn-label">`:
  - `data-mode="closest"` — pin SVG — label **`Closest`** — starts `.is-active`, `aria-pressed="true"`
  - `data-mode="soonest"` — clock SVG — label **`Soonest`** — `aria-pressed="false"`
  - `data-mode="map"` — folded-map SVG — label **`Map`** — `aria-pressed="false"`
- Active button: white text on `--red` background (`styles.css:1279`).

**Semantics** (`VIEW_MODES`, `applyViewMode`, `app.js:993-1049`):
| mode | `state.view` | `state.sortBy` |
|---|---|---|
| `closest` (default) | `list` | `distance` |
| `soonest` | `list` | `time` |
| `map` | `map` | *(unchanged)* |

- `applyViewMode` sets `#map.hidden = view !== "map"`, `#shows.hidden = view !== "list"`, and `.view-area[data-view]` to `list` / `map`.
- An order change resets `state.showCap = SHOW_PAGE` and re-renders the list.
- Entering map mode calls `state.map.invalidateSize()` (Leaflet can't measure a `display:none` container).
- Clicking the already-active mode is a no-op (`app.js:1044`).
- The chosen mode is persisted (`saveNowState`).

## 8. Show list & cards

`index.html:344-358`: `<div class="view-area" data-view="list"> <div class="view-panes"> <section id="map" class="map-section" hidden> … </section> <section id="shows" class="shows-section"> <div class="shows-grid" id="showsGrid"></div> <button id="showMore" class="show-more" type="button" hidden>Show more</button> </section>`.

**8.1 Which shows** (`fittingShows`, `app.js:869-886`):
- Start from `displayedShows()` — the filtered set classified as not `hidden`.
- **Exclude** the committed show (`show.id !== state.selectedShowId`).
- If a commitment exists and the selected leg show doesn't classify `ok` against it, that show is dropped from the list too (kept on map/plan).
- **Without a commitment**, only shows starting within `NOW.minutes + 120` minutes (`app.js:883`) — "the next couple of hours".

**8.2 Classification** (`classifyShow`, `app.js:476-502`) returns `selected | ok | tight | hidden`:
- `show.id === constraint.id` → `selected`.
- `travelMinutes(here, there) > state.maxTravelMinutes` → `hidden`.
- `arrival = NOW.minutes + travel`; `reachInTime = arrival <= start`; `tight = !reachInTime && (arrival - start) <= GRACE_MINUTES` (**GRACE_MINUTES = 5**, `app.js:87`).
- With a commitment: also require `start + show.duration + travel(show → constraint) <= constraint start`, else `hidden`; and then only `reachInTime` survives (a tight show is `hidden` once committed).
- Without a commitment: `ok` / `tight` / `hidden`.
- Travel time = `distanceKm(a,b) / speed * 60` where distance is **great-circle (haversine, R = 6371 km)** — straight-line, not street routing (`app.js:440-444`, `2711-2720`).

**8.3 Sorting**
- `distance`: `a.walk - b.walk || a.show.time.localeCompare(b.show.time)`.
- `time`: `a.show.time.localeCompare(b.show.time)`.
- `walk` = `Math.max(1, Math.round(travelMinutes(user, show)))` — never below 1.
- **Time sorting inserts group headings**: `<h3 class="shows-group-head">{clockLabel(show.time)}</h3>` per distinct start time (`app.js:932-938`). Distance sorting produces a flat list with no headings.

**8.4 Card markup** (`app.js:939-955`): `<article class="show-item show-item--{status}{ show-item--soldout}" tabindex="0" role="button">` containing:
- `showStamp(show, status)` (see 8.5)
- `.si-main`: `.show-genre` (genre, uppercase small red caps), `.show-name` (title, serif, ellipsised), `.show-meta` (venue), `subgenreTags(show)`
- `.si-side`: `.si-time` = `clockLabel(show.time)`, `<br>`, `.si-walk` = `` `🚶 ${walk} min · ${show.price}` ``, and **only when a commitment exists** `<br><span class="si-fits">fits</span>`

**8.5 Stamps** (`showStamp`, `app.js:2742-2746`) — diagonal ink stamps, `pointer-events: none`, `rotate(-7deg)`, Alfa Slab One, `text-transform: uppercase`, roughened by SVG filter `#stamp-ink` and a fractal-noise mask (`styles.css:1330-1356`; the filter is defined at `index.html:35-41`):
- `!show.available` → `<span class="show-stamp show-stamp--soldout">Sold out!</span>` (colour `#e2726b`) — **renders as "SOLD OUT!"**
- else `status === "tight"` → `<span class="show-stamp show-stamp--late">Too late!</span>` (colour `#d09a5b`) — **renders as "TOO LATE!"**
- else nothing. Both are display-only; the card stays clickable/selectable. On a `.show-item--selected` row the stamp fades to opacity 0.5.

**8.6 Availability rule** (`app.js:290, 296`): `available = !NO_TICKETS_STATUSES.has(ticketStatus)` where `NO_TICKETS_STATUSES = new Set(["SOLD_OUT", "NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE"])`. Everything else — including **unknown/null** — counts as available. The dataset's `ticketStatuses` vocabulary is `EVENT_SPECIFIC`, `FREE_NON_TICKETED`, `FREE_TICKETED`, `NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE`, `PREVIEW_SHOW`, `TICKETS_AVAILABLE`, `TWO_FOR_ONE` (note: literal `SOLD_OUT` is in the guard set but **not** in the current lookup list). The separate `soldOut` boolean flag is explicitly **not** trusted (`app.js:288-289, 1443`).

**8.7 Card state classes** (`styles.css:1314-1324`): `.show-item--tight` opacity 0.6; `.show-item--soldout` opacity 0.6; `.show-item--leg` 2px `--ok` border; `.show-item--selected` 2px `--red` border.

**8.8 Card interaction** (`app.js:956-971`): click, or `Enter`/`Space` keydown (with `preventDefault`), runs `onShowClick(show)`; if the show became the selected one, the page **smooth-scrolls to `top: 0`** (all the way up, not just to the plan). `onShowClick` (`app.js:751-755`): no-op if the show is the committed destination; otherwise toggles `state.legShowId` (clicking the same show again deselects it), then `refreshMap()`.

**8.9 Subgenre tags** (`subgenreTags`, `app.js:2731-2737`): `<span class="show-subs">` with one `<span class="show-sub">` per subgenre; returns `""` for shows with none (~2% per the comment) so the row is dropped.

**8.10 Empty states** (`app.js:914-923), rendered into `#showsGrid` as a `<p class="show-meta">`:
- **With** a commitment: `Nothing fits before your next commitment — try a later time or a wider travel window.`
- **Without**: `Nothing reachable in the next couple of hours — widen your travel window or taste.`
- `#showMore` is hidden in both cases.

**8.11 Pagination** — `SHOW_PAGE = 12` (`app.js:863`).
- `#showMore` label is rewritten to `` `Show ${Math.min(SHOW_PAGE, remaining)} more · ${remaining} left` `` e.g. `Show 12 more · 47 left` (`app.js:978`). Hidden when `remaining <= 0`.
- Click adds another `SHOW_PAGE` to `state.showCap` and re-renders (`app.js:2547-2553` — note it is wired inside `wireDebugControls`).
- The cap resets to 12 on: any taste-filter change, travel mode/slider change, view-order change, committing a show or place, and changing the constraint time.

## 9. Map

**9.1 Container** — `index.html:347-349`: `<section id="map" class="map-section" hidden><div id="leaflet-map" role="application" aria-label="Map of nearby Edinburgh Fringe shows"></div></section>`. Height **260 px**, 1px border, `border-radius: 14px` (`styles.css:1286`); **300 px** at `min-width: 720px` (`styles.css:1382-1385`). Tiles desaturated: `.leaflet-tile-pane { filter: saturate(0.82) brightness(1.03); }`.

**9.2 Leaflet setup** (`initMap`, `app.js:299-308`):
- `L.map("leaflet-map", { scrollWheelZoom: false })`, initial view `EDINBURGH = [55.9486, -3.1881]`, zoom **14**.
- Tile source: `https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png`, `maxZoom: 19`, attribution `© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors`.
- Leaflet 1.9.4 from `https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.{css,js}` with SRI hashes (`index.html:10-15, 387-391`).
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 from unpkg; **only** `MarkerCluster.css` is loaded (not `MarkerCluster.Default.css`) so the bubble is themed locally (`index.html:19-22, 392`).
- Attribution links styled in `--blue` with underline, font-size 0.65rem (`styles.css:1304-1306`).

**9.3 User marker** (`app.js:311-338`): `L.divIcon({ className: "user-marker", html: '<span class="user-dot"></span>', iconSize: [20,20], iconAnchor: [10,10] })`, `zIndexOffset: 1000`, `keyboard: false`. Popup text:
- Real location: `<p class="popup-title">You are here</p>`
- Default/pre-set: `<p class="popup-title">You are here (approx. central Edinburgh)</p>`
- `USER_DEFAULT = [55.9523946827963, -3.188258484671504]` (`app.js:40`).
- Recentring uses `setView(latlng, 15, { animate: true })`.

**9.4 Reach circle** (`renderReachCircle`, `app.js:669-688`): `L.circle` at the user, radius `reachRadiusMeters() = speed * (maxTravelMinutes/60) * 1000`, `color/fillColor "#6c4cf1"`, `weight 1.5`, `fillOpacity 0.08`, `interactive: false`. Bound hover tooltip: `` `~${state.maxTravelMinutes} min by ${state.travelMode}` `` e.g. `~10 min by Walking`, `direction: "top"`.

**9.5 Show pins** (`genrePin`/`pinIcon`, `app.js:562-579`): a `L.divIcon` with `className: "genre-pin"`, `iconSize [22,22]`, `iconAnchor [11,11]`, `tooltipAnchor [0,-11]`, html `<span class="gpin gpin--{status}" style="width:22px;height:22px;font-size:16px">{genre emoji}</span>`. **Every pin is the same size**; `.gpin--selected` / `.gpin--leg` get a violet tint + `--gold` ring instead of growing (`styles.css:1293-1296`).
- Opacity (`app.js:727`): dimmed pins **0.25** (any pin that isn't `selected`/`leg` while `state.legShowId` is set), `tight` pins **0.55**, otherwise **1**.
- `zIndexOffset`: `selected` 1000, `leg` 600, else 0.
- **No name tooltip** on show pins — deliberately (`app.js:730-732`).
- Clicking a pin runs `onShowClick(show)` and, unlike the list, **does not scroll the page** (`app.js:741-742`).

**9.6 Clustering** (`renderMarkers`, `app.js:697-744`): `L.markerClusterGroup({ maxClusterRadius: 26, spiderfyOnMaxZoom: true, showCoverageOnHover: false, iconCreateFunction: clusterIcon })`. `selected` and `leg` pins are added directly to the map (never clustered). If `L.markerClusterGroup` is unavailable (CDN failure) it **degrades to plain markers** rather than throwing.
- Cluster bubble (`clusterIcon`, `app.js:602-614`): `<span class="gcluster{ gcluster--dim}">{n}</span>`, size **30 px** (`n < 10`), **36 px** (`n < 50`), **42 px** (else); violet `--gold` disc, white 2px border. Gains `.gcluster--dim` (opacity 0.3, `styles.css:1302-1303`) whenever a show is focused, matching the dimmed pins.

**9.7 Place marker** (`renderPlaceMarker`, `app.js:584-598`): the committed non-show place gets `pinIcon(placeIcon(kind), "selected")` — same violet ring — `zIndexOffset: 1000`, and a **hover tooltip** with the place label (`direction: "top"`) because no card describes it.

**9.8 Route layers** (`renderRoute`/`drawLeg`, `app.js:758-845`):
- `L.polyline` with `className: "route-line"`, `color "#141414"`, `weight 3`, `opacity 0.9`, `interactive: false`.
- Arrowhead: a `L.divIcon` (`.route-arrow-wrap` / `.route-arrow`) placed at `lerp(from, to, 0.82)` and rotated to the great-circle `bearing(from, to)`.
- Green check pill anchored **exactly on the destination point** (`iconSize [0,0]`, `zIndexOffset: 1100`): `<span class="route-label route-check"><span class="tick">✓</span> {HH:MM}</span>` — the deadline your arrival beats.
- Leg shapes: no commitment + a selected show → one leg with the show's start as the check. Commitment + a fitting selected show → two legs (you→show with the show's start; show→commitment with the commitment's start). Commitment alone → one leg with the commitment's start.

**9.9 Pinning rules** (`displayedShows`, `app.js:505-538`): the committed show is always kept on the map even if outside the circle; the selected (`leg`) show is always kept too. Draw order sorted by `z = { ok: 0, tight: 0, leg: 1, selected: 2 }` so highlighted pins are drawn last/on top.

---

## 10. Data loading & errors

**10.1 Files fetched** (`loadShows`, `app.js:225-246`), in parallel:
- `data/venues.json` — TTL `LOOKUPS_TTL_MS = DAY_MS` (24 h). Supplies `venues`, `rooms`, `genres`, `subgenres`, `ticketStatuses`.
- `data/days/${NOW.fringeDate}.json` — TTL `DAY_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000` (**1 hour**, matching the hourly ticket refresh; rationale at `app.js:194-212`).
- `package.json` (uncached `fetch`) for the version string.

**10.2 Cache** (`shared/data-cache.js`): payloads in Cache Storage (`edfringe-data-v1`), timestamps in `localStorage["edfringe.data.fetched.v1"]` as a `url → epoch ms` map. Inside the TTL the cached body is returned with no network. On a failed refresh, a **stale cached copy wins** over an error. Degrades to plain `fetch` where Cache Storage isn't available (`file://`, plain http).

**10.3 Error surfaces — there are none.** Every failure path is console-only:
- `loadShows` catch → `console.error("Could not load show data:", err)` and `state.shows = []` (`app.js:242-245`). The user then sees the ordinary "Nothing reachable…" empty state, **not** an error message.
- `noteCache` → `console.info("Data cache —", url, err)` (`app.js:251-253`).
- Geolocation unsupported → `console.warn("Geolocation not supported; keeping default location.")`.
- Geolocation error → `console.info("Using default location:", err.message)`.
- Out-of-UK location → `console.info("Real location (…) is outside the UK — keeping the central Edinburgh default for testing.")`.
- Place search failure → `console.warn("Place search unavailable:", err)` **and** the visible `Map search isn’t reachable right now.` message (the only user-visible error string on the page).
- localStorage read/write failure → `console.info("EdFringeNow: couldn't read saved settings" / "couldn't save settings", err)`.
- Version fetch failure → `console.warn("EdFringeNow: couldn't read app version", err)`.

**10.4 Show record shape** (`adaptShow`, `app.js:262-292`):
- `id = ${entry.id}__${entry.start}__${index}` (unique per performance).
- Venue name fallback chain: `venues[code].name` → `` `Venue ${entry.venue}` `` → **`Venue TBC`**. With a room: `` `${venueName} — ${room}` `` (em dash).
- `duration = entry.duration || 60` (default 60 min).
- Shows whose venue has no lat/lng are **dropped entirely** (`app.js:239-241`).
- `price = entry.pm` when numeric, else `entry.free ? 0 : null`.

**10.5 Geolocation flow** (`requestUserLocation`, `app.js:341-372`): options `{ enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 60000 }`.
| Outcome | Effect |
|---|---|
| No `geolocation` in navigator | Keep central-Edinburgh default; debug menu stays hidden |
| Granted, position inside UK box | Move pin (`recenter: true, real: true`), popup becomes `You are here`, **and switch to the real clock** (`adoptRealClock()`); debug menu stays hidden |
| Granted, position outside UK box | Keep the default pin, keep the simulated clock, **reveal the debug menu** |
| Denied / unavailable / timed out | Keep central-Edinburgh default; debug menu stays hidden |

---

## 11. Time semantics

**11.1 The fringe day** (`shared/fringe-day.js`): a day runs **06:00 → 06:00**. `FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES = 360`, `FRINGE_DAY_END_MINUTES = 1800`. Times inside a day are minutes from that day's own midnight, range 360–1799; past-midnight times are ≥ 1440 and carry **extended `"HH:MM"`** strings (00:30 next morning = `"24:30"`) so string sorts/comparisons stay ordered. Only display wraps them back (`clockHHMM`, `clockLabel`, `hourLabel`).

**11.2 What "now" is** — the `NOW` object (`app.js:111-118`), initial simulated pre-set:
```
date: "2026-08-14", dateLabel: "Fri 14 Aug", time: "15:44", tz: "BST",
fringeDate: "2026-08-14", minutes: 944
```
backed by `simNowDate = festivalDate("2026-08-14T15:44")` (`app.js:124`).
- Every comparison against a show start uses `NOW.minutes`.
- The pre-set is replaced by the device clock **only** when geolocation confirms an in-UK position.

**11.3 Edinburgh wall-clock everywhere** (`js/clock.js`): `FESTIVAL_TZ = "Europe/London"`. `festivalNow(date)` reads any instant through `Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone, hourCycle: "h23", … })`, falling back to the device clock if the zone is unavailable. `festivalDate(local)` is the inverse (two correction passes to survive DST edges). `timeZoneLabel()` yields `BST`/`GMT`, returning `""` (so the previous label is kept) if the browser won't say.

**11.4 The ticker** (`startClockTicks`, `app.js:2576-2586`): only started once the real clock is adopted. Re-arms with `msToNextMinute(new Date())` (`clock.js:27-30`) so it fires **on** the minute rather than drifting; also re-syncs on `visibilitychange` when the tab becomes visible. Guarded so repeated `adoptRealClock()` calls (the header pin re-asks for location) can't stack timers.

**11.5 Tick suppression** (`syncToRealClock`, `app.js:2593-2598`): skips when nothing changed, and **skips while any `.card.is-open`** — re-rendering would repopulate the wheels out from under someone using them; the next tick catches up.

**11.6 Day rollover** (`applyNow`, `app.js:2603-2636`): reloads the per-day file **only when `NOW.fringeDate` changes** — i.e. at 06:00, **not** at midnight. Then rebuilds the genre panel, subgenre panel, constraint panel, map and list.

**11.7 Time-dependent behaviours**
- List without a commitment: only shows starting `<= NOW.minutes + 120` (2 hours).
- Wheel opens at now + 120 min, offers now → 29:55.
- `constraintShows()`: `start >= NOW.minutes`.
- Show cards do **not** render a "starts in X min" string — the card side shows the absolute start time (`.si-time`) and walk minutes (`.si-walk`). The relative-time language lives on the plan's slack chips ("… to spare", "N min late") and the spare-time prompt.
- Sold-out data freshness is bounded by the 1-hour day-file TTL.

**11.8 Plan restoration & staleness** (`adoptRestoredPlan`, `app.js:2372-2401`):
- A commitment is stale when the saved fringe date ≠ today's, **or** `isPastTime(selectedTime)` (`<= NOW.minutes`, `app.js:2366-2368`), **or** its show is no longer in today's data, **or** its show's start has passed.
- A picked leg show is stale when the day differs, or the show is gone, or it has started.
- Stale items are **dropped silently and permanently** — nothing is offered back, nothing to dismiss.
- `buildConstraintPanel` (`app.js:1898-1912`) additionally drops a `selectedTime` earlier than `earliestWheelMinutes(NOW.minutes)` **only** if nothing real (a still-present show or a non-empty destLabel) is behind it.

---

## 12. Persistence

- `STORE_KEY = "edfringenow.now.v1"` — one JSON object holding `date` (the **fringe** date), `genres`, `subgenres`, `price`, `travelMode`, `maxTravelMinutes`, `viewMode`, plus the plan snapshot (`selectedTime`, `selectedShowId`, `legShowId`, `destLabel`, `destPlace`, `destNote`) (`app.js:2273, 2306-2330`).
- Written only once `state.ready` is true (set at the end of `init()`), and `refreshMap()` is the single save point (`app.js:626`).
- Restore validation (`app.js:2334-2363`): genres filtered against `GENRES`; price must be in `PRICE_FILTERS`; travel mode must be in `TRAVEL_MODES`; `maxTravelMinutes` clamped to 1–60 and rounded; `viewMode` must be a `VIEW_MODES` key.
- `LEGACY_STALE_KEY = "edfringenow.now.stale.v1"` is **deleted on every load** (`app.js:2277, 2337`).
- `INTRO_KEY = "edfringenow.now.intro.v1"` — separate, never cleared with a stale plan.

---

## 13. Footer

`index.html:363-385`, `<footer class="site-footer">` → `.container.footer-inner`.

**13.1 Brand column**
- `<p class="logo logo--footer">EdFringe<span class="logo-now">Now</span></p>`
- `<p class="footer-tagline">Helping you navigate the chaos and catch another show!</p>`
- `<p class="footer-copy"><span id="footerVersion" class="footer-version">© 2026 Missing Bulb</span></p>` — `cursor: help` (`styles.css:759`); its `title` attribute is set to `` `EdFringeNow v${pkg.version}` `` by `loadAppVersion()` (`app.js:2498`). This is **the version anyone can reach**, since the debug pill is hidden for most visitors.
- `<p class="footer-copy">Booking links on plans (tables, trains, stays, tours) may earn us a small commission, at no extra cost to you.</p>`

**13.2 Quick Links column** — `<h3 class="footer-heading">Quick Links</h3>`
- `<a href="mailto:support@edfringenow.com" class="footer-link">Contact Us</a>`
- `<a href="privacy.html" class="footer-link">Privacy Policy</a>` (page title `Privacy — EdFringeNow`)

**13.3 Legal column** — `<h3 class="footer-heading">Legal</h3>`
- `<a href="accessibility.html" class="footer-link">Accessibility</a>` (page title `Accessibility — EdFringeNow`)
- `<a href="terms.html" class="footer-link">Terms of Use</a>` (page title `Terms of Use — EdFringeNow`)

---

## 14. Anything else user-visible

**14.1 Document head** (`index.html:6-7`)
- `<title>EdFringeNow — Catch an Edinburgh Fringe show right now</title>`
- `<meta name="description" content="Find the nearest Edinburgh Fringe magic happening right now, near you — and still make your next thing. Your spontaneous adventure starts here.">`
- Fonts from Google: `Alfa Slab One` (stamps only), `Inter` (400/600/700/800), `Plus Jakarta Sans` (600/700/800), `display=swap`.

**14.2 Boot order** (`init`, `app.js:162-190`): `renderDebugBanner` → `wireDebugControls` → `initMap` → `setUserLocation(USER_DEFAULT, {recenter:false})` → `requestUserLocation()` → `restoreNowState` → `initIntro` → build genre/price/travel panels → `wirePanels` → `wireViewSwitch` → wire `#locBtn` → `await loadShows()` → `adoptRestoredPlan` → `buildSubgenrePanel` → `buildConstraintPanel` → `refreshMap` → `renderShowList` → chip labels → `refreshFacetCounts` → `state.ready = true` → `saveNowState`. So the map, the default pin and the empty panels exist **before** any data arrives.

**14.3 Focus styling** — `.nav-link`, `.icon-btn`, `.footer-link`, `.show-item`, `.show-more`, `.view-btn`, `.seg-btn`, `.intro-got`, `.intro-x`, `.spare-jump`, `.plan-spare-x`, `.plan-book-x` all take `outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px` on `:focus-visible` (`styles.css:351, 991, 1237, 1241, 1281, 1372-1374`).

**14.4 Reduced-motion**: three separate blocks disable animation — journey walker/dots/buy (`styles.css:667-671`), the whole intro stage with end-states forced (`996-1000`), and the count bump + pick-list stagger (`1377-1379`). `tweenCount` also checks `matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)")` in JS (`app.js:2215`).

**14.5 Responsive**: `@media (max-width: 560px)` reflows `.journey-row` to a column; `@media (max-width: 860px)` hides `.main-nav` and collapses `.constraint-cards` to one column; `@media (min-width: 720px)` widens the `.wrap` gutter to 28 px and raises the map to 300 px.

**14.6 Escaping**: all interpolated show/venue/place text goes through `escapeHtml` (`app.js:2722-2726`) escaping `& < > " '`.

**14.7 Analytics** (`js/analytics.js`): Cloudflare Web Analytics, cookieless, **inert by default** — the token placeholder `REPLACE_WITH_CLOUDFLARE_WEB_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` causes an early return, so no beacon is requested and there is no consent banner anywhere in the UI.

**14.8 Build stamp** (`js/build-info.js`): sets `window.__BUILD__ = { time: "" }`, overwritten at deploy. It is loaded but **not read** by the current `app.js` — the pill and footer tooltip both use `package.json`'s version instead.

### Known small inconsistencies worth pinning in the spec
1. `index.html:233` ships `Happening now near you` as the heading, but the first render always replaces it — that string is never seen after boot, and never seen at all if data loads.
2. `index.html:241` ships `Comedy` as the genre chip's static value; `updateGenreValue()` overwrites it at boot (default state is `new Set(["Comedy"])`, so it happens to agree — but a restored multi-genre selection will not).
3. `#showMore`'s markup label is `Show more`; the JS always rewrites it to `Show N more · M left` before it is un-hidden.
4. Sold-out wording differs by surface: card stamp `Sold out!` (uppercased by CSS) vs plan pill `Sold out`.
5. `renderShowList` finds the heading by `.shows-title` class, not by `#showsTitle`.
6. `#showMore`'s click handler is registered inside `wireDebugControls()`, not with the other list wiring.
7. `NO_TICKETS_STATUSES` includes `"SOLD_OUT"`, which does not appear in the current `data/venues.json` `ticketStatuses` vocabulary — only `NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE` can fire the stamp from live data.</result>
