## 9. Schedule graphic (`#schedule` inside `#scheduleWrap`)

### Axis
- Fixed festival axis **09:00 → 27:00 (03:00)**: `AXIS_TOP_MIN = 540`, `AXIS_BOTTOM_MIN = 1620`, `DAY_END_CEIL = 1620` (`plan.js:83-85`).
- The axis only ever **grows** past that span — never shrinks — to hold an unusually early day start, a late day end, an enabled meal band, or a show running into the small hours (`plan.js:2997-3018`).
- Hour height `SCH_HOUR_PX = 34`; head `SCH_HEAD_PX = 46`; left gutter `SCH_GUTTER_PX = 52` (`plan.js:2857-2871`).
- Left gutter labels: `${pad2(h)}:00` for every hour; hours ≥24 get class `sch-hour--late` and **keep counting** (`24:00`, `25:00`, `26:00`, `27:00`) so the same festival night reads as one continuous evening (`plan.js:3026-3041`).

### Day columns
- **Every day in the window is drawn**, not just the ones with shows — drawing only full days made a plan look denser than it was (`plan.js:3045-3061`). A scheduled day that falls outside the current window is appended rather than silently vanishing.
- A day earns a **full column** when it has ≥1 show, or when it is the arrival/departure boundary day with its trip block enabled. Everything else collapses to `SCH_EMPTY_COL_PX = 30` with class `sch-day--empty` (`plan.js:3066-3069`).
- Weekend columns get class `wknd` (`plan.js:3090`).
- Head, full column: `<div class="sch-dow">${DOW_LONG[dow]} <span class="sch-date">${dayNum} Aug</span></div>` + `<div class="sch-day-count">${n} show${n===1?"":"s"}</div>` where `DOW_LONG = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"]` (`plan.js:2873`, `3097-3099`).
- Head, collapsed column: just the day number in `.sch-dow--empty`; the column carries `title="${DOW_LONG} ${dayNum} Aug — nothing planned"` (`plan.js:3100-3101`).
- Width breakpoints on the host: `cols-narrow` when the flexed column width < 78px (drops the tiny start–end time), `cols-tiny` when < 56px (also drops the genre emoji, so the title always wins the space) (`plan.js:3080-3081`).

### Show blocks (`a.sch-show`, `buildScheduleBlock`, `plan.js:3314-3347`)
- It is an **`<a href>`** to the edfringe.com page (`target="_blank" rel="noopener" draggable="false"`), so right-click / middle-click / long-press "open link" works natively. A **plain left-click is intercepted** to pin the performance instead (`plan.js:3949-3962`).
- Classes: `sch-show` + `statusSegClass(status)` + `sch-show--pinned` when forced.
- Minimum height `SCH_MIN_BLOCK = 34px`; adds `sch-show--tight` below `SCH_TIGHT_PX = 42px`, which drops the start–end time and clamps the title to one line — the axis beside the block already says when it is, and the venue is the fact you can't get anywhere else (`plan.js:2859-2865, 3329`).
- Contents: optional `.sch-pin` `🔒`, `.sch-emoji` genre emoji, `.sch-name` title, `.sch-meta` containing `.sch-time` `${startTime}–${slotEndTime}` and `.sch-venue` (`venueName || venueCode`, omitted when blank).
- **No native `title`** — the rich hover card carries all of it.

**Genre emoji** (`GENRE_EMOJI`, `plan.js:108-122`): Comedy 😂 · Theatre 🎭 · Cabaret and Variety 🎪 · Children's Shows 🧸 · Dance, Physical Theatre & Circus 💃 · Events ✨ · Exhibitions 🖼️ · Music 🎵 · Musicals and Opera 🎶 · Spoken Word 🗣️ · **fallback 🎟️**.

### Travel legs (`.sch-leg`, `buildTravelLeg`, `plan.js:3350-3400`)
Drawn **only** between consecutive same-day shows whose gap is `0 ≤ gap < 60` minutes (`plan.js:3108-3113`).

| Case | `.leg-text` | `title` |
|---|---|---|
| Same venue code | `same venue · ${gap}′ gap` | `${venueName \|\| "Same venue"} — no travel, ${gap} min between shows` |
| Coordinates unknown | `nearby · ${gap}′ gap` | `Travel time unknown (venue has no coordinates)` |
| Known | `${round(mins)}′ · ${km.toFixed(1)}km · ${spare}` where spare = `+N′` or `-N′` | `${modeEmoji} ${mins} min ${verb} · ${km} km from ${A} to ${B} — ${gap} min gap, ${spare} min spare` |

`MODE_META` verbs: walk → `walk`, bike → `by bike`, car → `by car` (`plan.js:125-129`). Primes rather than "min" so three facts fit the line; the signed slack goes unlabelled in the pill because spelling out "spare" pushed the line past the pill in a normal-width column (`plan.js:3386-3394`). `.leg-emoji` carries the current mode's emoji.

### Draggable overlay (`.sch-overlay`, `buildScheduleOverlay`, `plan.js:3404-3449`)
- Two shaded `.sch-zone` regions: "before day starts" (top) and "after day ends" (bottom), each with a themed emoji scatter.
- **Boundary inset**: the day-start line + top zone skip the first column when the arrival block is enabled; the day-end line + bottom zone skip the last column when departure is enabled — the trip blocks own those edges instead (`plan.js:3416-3417, 3444-3446`).
- **Day lines** (`.sch-dayline--start` / `--end`): `.dl-grip` + `.dl-flag` reading `Day starts ${HH:MM}` / `Day ends ${clock}`. The end uses the **extended** clock (`25:00`), the start the plain one (`plan.js:3451-3466`). Live label rewrite during drag (`plan.js:3809-3818`).
- **Meal bands** (`.sch-meal`, enabled only): min height 6px; centre label `${HH:MM}–${HH:MM} · 🍽 ${Name}` (e.g. `12:30–13:30 · 🍽 Lunch`), plus `.meal-resize--top` / `--bottom` grips (`plan.js:3594-3615`).
- **Conflict triangle on board labels** (`exclMarkHTML`, `plan.js:3588-3592`): `<span class="excl-mark" data-excl="…" aria-label="excludes ${n} show${s}">▲</span>` — the same red triangle the lane pills use, so "conflict" reads the same on day lines, meal bands and trip blocks as it does on the grid. Rendered only when the list is non-empty.

### Drag mechanics
| Target | Bounds | On release |
|---|---|---|
| Day-start line | `clamp(min, 0, effectiveDayEnd()-15)` | `refresh()` |
| Day-end line | `clamp(min, dayStartMin+15, 1620)` | `refresh()` |
| Meal band top grip | `clamp(min, 0, endMin-10)` | `refresh()` |
| Meal band bottom grip | `clamp(min, startMin+10, 1440)` | `refresh()` |
| Meal band body (move) | keeps length; `clamp(s0+Δ, 0, 1440-len)` | `refresh()` |
| Arrival block lower edge | `clamp(min, axisTop, effectiveDayEnd())` | `refresh()` |
| Departure block upper edge | `clamp(min, dayStartMin, axisBottom)` | `refresh()` |

All snap to **5-minute** increments (`minuteFromClientY`, `plan.js:3783-3790`). During a drag only the overlay repositions live (`repositionOverlayLive`, `plan.js:3794-3835`) — the full re-plan happens on pointer release. Time inputs in the preferences strip are synced live during the drag (`syncDayInputs` / `syncMealInputs`). Sources: `plan.js:3742-3780, 3837-3903`.

### Trip blocks (`buildTripBlock`, `plan.js:3706-3740`)
Rendered **inside their own day column body**, behind the shows, so they stay on that one day.
- Arrival: `title="Getting there — drag the lower edge; no shows are placed before this on your first day"`; label `🚆 Arrive ${HH:MM}` (default 11:00).
- Departure: `title="Getting out — drag the upper edge; no shows are placed after this on your last day"`; label `🧳 Leave ${extended clock}` (default 22:00).
- Both default `enabled: true` (`plan.js:209-210`).
- Both carry the `▲` exclusion triangle when the block alone shuts shows out.

### Partner nags (`plan.js:3617-3701`, `shared/affiliates.js`)
Two kinds, each a small pill inside a region that already exists:

| Kind | Emoji | Question | Where | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sleep` | 🛏️ | `Need a place to sleep?` | the "after day ends" night zone | `stayLink()` → text `Find a bed`, partner `Booking.com`, Booking search for Edinburgh with the trip's own check-in (`d0`) / check-out (`d1`) |
| `travel` | 🎟️ | `Transportation sorted?` | **both** trip blocks (arrival and departure) | `travelLink()` → text `Trains, coaches & flights`, partner `Omio`, `https://www.omio.com/travel/edinburgh` |

- CTA `title`: `${question} ${text} on ${partner} — partner link, we may earn a commission`.
- `rel="sponsored noopener noreferrer"`, `target="_blank"`.
- Close button `.nag-x`: text `×`, `aria-label="Hide the “${question}” suggestion"`. Click is `preventDefault`+`stopPropagation` so it doesn't reach the draggable furniture underneath. Dismissal removes **every** copy of that nag and persists with no TTL (`plan.js:3670-3701`).
- A region shorter than `NAG_MIN_PX = 30` simply omits the nag; a drag that squeezes the region hides it live and dropping the drag rebuilds it (`plan.js:3642-3693`).
- Checkout guard: a checkout not after check-in becomes the next morning, so a one-day window doesn't ask Booking.com for a zero-night stay (`affiliates.js:74-92`).
- Affiliate IDs ship empty by default — every link works as a plain untagged deep link (`affiliates.js:37-49`).

### Exclusion popup (`#exclPop`, `wireExcludePopup`, `plan.js:3971-4013`)
Cursor-following popup, delegated over `#schedule` for any `[data-excl]` target.
- `.excl-pop-head`: `Excludes ${n} show${n===1?"":"s"}`.
- `.excl-pop-list`: up to **14** titles, one `<li>` each.
- `.excl-pop-more`: `+${more} more` when over 14.

- New show in a brand-new column → rides that column's entrance instead (no double motion).

## 11. Time semantics

1. **Fringe day boundary = 06:00.** `FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES = 360`. The day named `2026-08-14` runs 06:00 on the 14th to 06:00 on the 15th. 06:00 is the seam because the catalogue has nothing at all between 00:30 and 06:00, so the join falls where nobody is looking. Half-open: a 06:00 show belongs to the morning it happens in, not the night before (`shared/fringe-day.js:33-42`).
2. **One boundary, defined once.** The scraper buckets day files by it, the Now page picks its day file and its "now" by it, the time wheel stops at it, and the planner folds its late shows by it — `NIGHT_FOLD_CUTOFF_MIN = FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES` (`shared/fringe-day.js:22-30`, `lib/engine.js:159`).
3. **Night fold.** A performance starting before 06:00 is re-dated to the **previous** calendar day and its minute-of-day gains 1440 (00:45 → 24:45). Real wall-clock start/end and real date are preserved on the slot (`realDate`) for exports and chronological ordering (`lib/engine.js:176-181`, `269-291`).
4. **Window membership is by festival date** when date bounds are given — so a Friday 00:45 late show counts as Friday night, and a show on the morning after the last day does not leak in (`lib/engine.js:254, 270-272`).
5. **Extended clock strings.** `"24:30"` is the stored form (keeps every string comparison, sort and lookup key correctly ordered); only the display layer wraps it back to `"00:30"` via `clockHHMM` / `hourLabel` (`shared/fringe-day.js:16-20, 50-70`). In the planner: `minToDayClock` (`plan.js:152-155`) prints the extended form and is used for the day-end input, the day-end line flag and the departure label; `minToHHMM` (`plan.js:143-146`) caps at 23:59 and is used for the day-start input, meal times and the arrival label; `hhmm` (`plan.js:1293-1295`) wraps mod-24 and is used **inside conflict tips**.
6. **The schedule axis is 09:00–27:00 (03:00)** and the day-end control may be set as late as 27:00 — a Fringe evening runs past midnight, and a native `<time>` input can't express that (`plan.js:80-85`, `index.html:406-419`).
7. **Default day hours 09:00 – 25:00 (01:00)** so ordinary late-night shows are catchable out of the box (`plan.js:87-90`).
8. **Wall-clock, not instants.** `dateTimeToMinutes` uses `Date.UTC` deliberately — a pure wall-clock minute count with no timezone conversion, because shows.json stores local Edinburgh wall-clock times and every performance/filter in the app uses the same convention (`lib/availability.js:73-79`). `itinerary.js` reads them back with `getUTC*` accessors to recover the original Edinburgh wall-clock with no drift (`itinerary.js:10-29`).
9. **Duration is derived**, not shipped: `end = start + show.duration`; when duration is absent `end === start` (`lib/availability.js:114-117`, `lib/engine.js:264`).
10. **Default trip window**: Aug 7 → Aug 24 (18 days), which is why `#railLen`'s markup placeholder reads `18 days` (`plan.js:77-78`, `index.html:135`).

- Venue find box `#ssfVenueFind`: `placeholder="Find a venue…"`, `aria-label="Find a venue in this list"`. Typing narrows rows by substring; Escape with text clears the box first rather than closing the panel (`index.html:300-301`, `plan.js:2019-2039`).

**Option rows** (`buildFacetPanel`, `plan.js:1940-1980`):
- Each row = `<input type=checkbox|radio>` + label + `.opt-count` grey number, `aria-label="${n} show(s)"`.

**Coming-soon / degraded facets:**
- Accessibility: whole chip gets class `is-disabled` and `title="Accessibility data hasn't landed in our catalogue yet — coming soon"` when the catalogue declares zero accessibility values (`plan.js:1843-1844`, `2289-2291`).
- Price caps: each non-`free` option is disabled with `title="No ticket prices scraped yet — “Free” already works"` when no paid show carries a price (`plan.js:1873-1874`).

**Age option labels**: values `["0","3","5","8","12","14","16"]`; `"0"` → `0+ only`, otherwise `Up to ${v}+` (`plan.js:1851-1852`).
**Price option labels** (from `shared/price.js:105-109`): `Free`, `Up to £10`, `Up to £15`, `Up to £20`, `Up to £30`. Deliberately "Up to", not "Under" — the cap is inclusive.

**Chip value text** (`plan.js:2272-2280`): 0 chosen → the facet's `any` string; 1 chosen → that option's label; ≥2 → `${count} ${noun}` where noun ∈ `genres` / `subgenres` / `venues` / `access needs`.

**"everything!" link** (`.panel-everything`, `plan.js:2281-2286`, `2363-2373`):
- Text `everything!` normally; flips to `nothing!` once every option in a multi facet is ticked.
- `title`: `Untick every option` (all ticked) / `Tick every option` (multi, not all) / `Back to any` (single-answer facets).
- Behaviour: single-answer → clears to `""`; multi with all ticked → clears; multi otherwise → ticks every option.

**Panel positioning**: `clampChipPanel` keeps an open panel ≥8px inside the viewport by `translateX` (`plan.js:2314-2322`). Re-run for every open panel whenever chip labels change width (`plan.js:2300`).

### Results overlay (`#ssPop`)
- `#ssResults` — `<ul role="listbox" aria-label="Matching categories and shows">`.
- `#ssEmpty` — `No shows match — try fewer filters or a different spelling.` Shown whenever `rows.length === 0` (`index.html:364`, `plan.js:2127`).
- `#ssFoot` — shown only when results were capped: `Showing ${shown} of ${total} matches — keep typing to narrow it down` (`plan.js:2129-2134`). Cap = `SEARCH_LIMIT = 30` (`plan.js:1758`).

**Category rows** (`.ss-row.ss-row--facet`, up to `FACET_SUGGESTION_LIMIT = 4`, always **above** show rows) — `plan.js:2147-2166`:
- Filter-lines SVG + `.ss-facet-kind` (`Genre` / `Subgenre` / `Venue`) + `.ss-row-title` (label) + `.ss-facet-hint` `Filter to ${count} show(s)`.
- `aria-label`: `Filter to ${Kind} ${label} — ${count} shows`.
- Suggested only when the query is **≥2 characters** (`lib/search.js:280`), and only for values not already ticked (`plan.js:2107`).
- Picking one: ticks that facet value, **clears the query box**, opens the tools strip, re-searches, refocuses the input (`plan.js:2209-2215`).

**Show rows** (`.ss-row`, `.is-on` when already a favourite) — `plan.js:2168-2201`:
- `.ss-star` button: `★` when on the grid, `☆` when not. `aria-label` = `Remove ${title} from your grid` / `Add ${title} to your grid` (`plan.js:2139-2141`).
- `.ss-row-title` = show title.
- `.ss-row-meta` = `price · genre · venueName · typicalStartTime`, joined with ` · `, empty parts dropped. **Price is omitted entirely when unknown** — `showPrice(show) === null ? null : priceLabel(show)` (`plan.js:2189-2197`).
- The star and the whole line do the same thing (`plan.js:2415-2420`).

### Search ranking (`lib/search.js`)
- Fold: lowercase + NFD accent-strip, so `cafe` finds `Café` (`search.js:136-141`).
- Score: title prefix = 4; word-boundary in title = 3; anywhere in title = 2; hit in company/venue = 1; hit found **only** in the description = 0.5 (extends the tail, never reorders the head). Multi-word queries must land every token (`search.js:161-181`).
- Empty query + no filters → nothing, popup closed. Empty query + filters → whole filtered list A→Z ("browse by facet"). Ties break A→Z (`search.js:201-221`).
- `describe` prefers the descriptions sidecar, falls back to the catalogue blurb — the same query reaches deeper the longer the page is open (`plan.js:2097-2099`).
- Facet suggestion ordering: score, then facet breadth (`genre` > `subgenre` > `venue`), then show count desc, then A→Z (`search.js:263, 295-301`).

### Keyboard & focus behaviour (`plan.js:2387-2445`)
- `input` → debounced `runSearch` at **120 ms**.
- `focus` → re-runs the search **only if** the box still has text or a filter is active.
- `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` → wrap-around move through the combined row list; opens the popup if closed; sets `aria-activedescendant` and scrolls the row into view (`plan.js:2246-2260`).
- `Enter` on an active row → activates it (star toggle, or apply category filter).
- `Escape` with popup open → closes the popup (stops propagation so it doesn't reach other Escape handlers).
- **Dismiss semantics (`dismissSearch`, `plan.js:2075-2082`)**: click-away outside `#showSearch`, or `focusout` to a known target outside it, **clears the query text** and closes the overlay. **Filters are deliberately kept** — they live on the tools line, which stays as set. A click whose target is already detached (re-render from picking a category row) is *not* treated as "away" (`plan.js:2436`).

## 6. Scheduling engine — user-visible rules and conflict labels

### What the scheduler is given (`gatherPlanOptions`, `plan.js:2903-2926`)
`dateStart`/`dateEnd` from the window (membership by **festival date**), `minGapDifferentVenue` = the gap select, `minGapSameVenue = 0`, `maxPerDay = clamp(ctlMax, 1, 8)`, `minPerDay = ctlMin`, `dayStartMin`, `dayEndMin = effectiveDayEnd()`, enabled meal breaks, arrival/departure blocks keyed to the first/last day of the window, forced slugs + pinned performances, travel mode, venue coordinates.

### What makes a slot ineligible / conflicting

1. **Availability** — a performance is bookable unless `soldOut` or its status is in `UNAVAILABLE_STATUSES`: `SOLD_OUT`, `SOLD OUT`, `SOLDOUT`, `OFF_SALE`, `OFFSALE`, `NOT_ON_SALE`, `NOT_YET_ON_SALE`, `COMING_SOON`, `CANCELLED`, `CANCELED`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `POSTPONED`, `SUSPENDED`, `NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE`. **A blank/absent status is also unavailable** (`lib/availability.js:20-49`). Offer statuses (`TWO_FOR_ONE`, `PAY_WHAT_YOU_WANT`) stay available.
2. **Date window** — the slot's *festival* date must fall in `[dateStart, dateEnd]` (`lib/engine.js:254, 270-272`).
3. **Day hours** — `startMinuteOfDay >= dayStartMin` **and** `endMinuteOfDay <= dayEndMin` (`lib/engine.js:353-363`).
4. **Meal breaks** — half-open overlap: fails when `slot.start < break.end && slot.end > break.start`. A show touching a break edge-to-edge is fine (`lib/engine.js:358-361`).
5. **Trip blocks** — modelled as date-specific meal breaks. On the arrival date, the "getting there" block **replaces** the day start (`dayStartMin → 0`, break `[0, arrival.endMin]`). On the departure date it replaces the day end (`dayEndMin → ∞`, break `[departure.startMin, ∞)`) (`lib/engine.js:498-514`).
6. **Overlap + travel gap** — two slots are `compatible` iff `later.start >= earlier.end + requiredGapMinutes(earlier, later)` (`lib/engine.js:400-403`).
7. **Per-day cap** — a candidate is dropped if its day already holds `maxPerDay` shows (`lib/engine.js:587`).
8. **Per-day minimum (post-pass)** — a day holding fewer than `minPerDay` shows, **and no forced show**, is dropped whole; its shows become unscheduled (`lib/engine.js:594-600`).

### Travel time and how mode affects it (`lib/travel.js`, `lib/engine.js:377-390`)
- Same **known** venue code on both slots → `minGapSameVenue` (0 in the UI) — a double bill needs no travel.
- Different venues → `max(minGapDifferentVenue, ceil(travelMinutes))`, i.e. the gap select is a **floor** and travel only *adds* time when it exceeds it. This is exactly what the mode-button tooltips say: `Walking time between venues — used when it's longer than the gap` (and the bike/car equivalents) — written that way to head off the assumption that bike/car simply mean "faster" (`index.html:483-492`).
- Unknown / missing coordinates (online venue) → fall back to the flat `minGapDifferentVenue`.
- Distance: haversine crow-flies, R = 6371 km. Speeds: **walk 3.33 km/h** (`(5*2)/3` — deliberately dialled to ⅔ of brisk walking for Edinburgh's closes, hills, stairs and crowds), **bike 15 km/h**, **car 22 km/h** (a car in the congested August centre is only a little quicker than a bike). Default mode `walk` (`travel.js:13-28, 53-83`).

### Allocation order (`buildSchedule`, `lib/engine.js:456-645`)
- **Pass 1 — forced (must-see)**: forced slugs in sorted order. A slug pinned to an exact performance takes that one **straight from the pre-day-hours pool**, so an explicit pin overrides day hours, meal breaks and trip blocks. A whole-show pin tries unblocked performances first (earliest-finishing), then blocked ones. Pass 1 **ignores the per-day cap** but cannot overlap another must-see.
- **Pass 2 — greedy earliest-finish-first** activity selection over everything else, ties broken deterministically by `end → start → slug → date`. One performance per show. Same inputs always yield the same plan — no clock, no randomness.
- **Post-pass** — min-per-day drop (above), never touching a day with a forced show.

### `unscheduled` reasons (engine strings — **not currently rendered in the UI**)
`lib/engine.js:625-630` produces one of:
- `no available performance in your dates`
- `forced, but it clashes with another must-see`
- `only runs outside your day hours or meal breaks`
- `on a day below your minimum`
- `clashes with shows already in your plan`

These strings reach the user **only** through the debug JSON download (`plan.js:2548`). The lane pills below are the UI's independent vocabulary for the same situations. Flag this as a spec decision point.

### Lane verdict pills — the visible conflict vocabulary
`laneStatus` (`plan.js:1067-1098`) classifies each lane; `statusPillHTML` (`plan.js:1139-1167`) renders it. Every pill is preceded by `<span class="st-pin">🔒</span>` when the show is pinned (`plan.js:1249-1252`).

| Kind | Condition | Rendered HTML / exact copy | Colour |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scheduled` | in the plan | `<span class="st-plan">✓&nbsp;Scheduled!</span>` | `--ok-text` on `--ok-bg`, pill (`plan.css:716-719`) |
| `early` | catchable, but `placementDiagnostics.dayStart` blames the day start alone | button `▲Too early` → jumps to `#ctlDayStart` | `#9a6700`, warn triangle `--warn` |
| `late` | day end alone | button `▲Too late` → `#ctlDayEnd` | same |
| `lunch` | lunch break alone | button `▲Lunch conflict` → `#mealLunchStart` | same |
| `dinner` | dinner break alone | button `▲Dinner conflict` → `#mealDinnerStart` | same |
| `meal` | exactly the two culprits `lunch` + `dinner` | button `▲Meal conflict` → `#mealLunchStart` | same |
| `combo` (2 culprits) | any other 2-culprit mix | button `▲` + `comboLabel` = the two `COMBO_SHORT` words joined ` + `, first letter capitalised — e.g. `Lunch + late`, `Early + late`, `Dinner + late` | same |
| `combo` (≥3, or 0 nameable) | ≥3 culprits, or blocked with no single rescuing control | `▲Hours + meals` when any meal break is enabled, else `▲Day hours` | same |
| `cantfit` | catchable in the window, but a clash or the per-day cap left no room | `<span class="st-cant">Can't fit</span>` | `--muted`, weight 600 |
| `sold` | every performance in the window — or the whole run — is sold out | `<span class="st-sold">Sold out</span>` | `#98a2b3`, weight 700 |
| `baddates` (default) | has bookable performances, but all outside the dates | `<span class="st-dates">📅 No dates</span>` | `--violet-dark`, weight 600 |

Culprit detection order is `["lunch","dinner","early","late"]` — meals first (they're the draggable bands), then the day edges (`plan.js:1079`). `sold` **takes priority over** `baddates`: a different window won't help a sold-out run (`plan.js:1091-1097`).

`COMBO_SHORT = {lunch:"lunch", dinner:"dinner", early:"early", late:"late"}`; `COMBO_FULL = {lunch:"Lunch break", dinner:"Dinner break", early:"Day start", late:"Day end"}` — two vocabularies because the pill has ~14 characters of column and the tip title has room for full words (`plan.js:1113-1115`).

Rendered into `#calTip`, positioned centred over the pill, above when there's room, else below, clamped to the viewport (`plan.js:1384-1401`). Three paragraphs: `.tip-title`, `.tip-desc.tip-desc--lead`, `.tip-hint`.

| Kind | `.tip-title` | `.tip-desc` | `.tip-hint` |
|---|---|---|---|
| meal (`lunch`/`dinner`) | `Lunch conflict` / `Dinner conflict` | `Every performance of this show runs during your ${kind} break (${HH:MM}–${HH:MM}), so the plan can't take it.` | `Click to go to the setting and change it` |
| `meal` | `Meal conflict` | `Every performance of this show runs during one of your meal breaks, so the plan can't take it.` | same |
| `early` | `Too early` | `Every performance starts before your day does (${HH:MM}).` | same |
| `late` | `Too late` | `Every performance runs past the end of your day (${HH:MM}).` | same |
| `combo` (named) | `COMBO_FULL` names joined ` + ` (e.g. `Lunch break + Day end`) | `No single setting blocks this show — together they do: ` + clauses joined `; ` + `. Changing any one of these would free at least one performance.` | `Click to go to the settings responsible` |
| `combo` (unnamed) | `Day hours + meal breaks` | `Every performance of this show trips two of your settings at once (day hours, meal breaks), so no single change will free one — it takes two.` | `Click to go to the settings responsible` |

Combo clauses (`comboClause`, `plan.js:1298-1303`), in the user's own numbers:
- meal → `some run during your ${id} break (${HH:MM}–${HH:MM})`
- `early` → `some start before your day does (${HH:MM})`
- `late` → `some run past the end of your day (${HH:MM})`

Note the times use `hhmm()` which wraps hours mod 24 (`plan.js:1293-1295`) — so a day end of 25:00 reads `01:00` inside a tip, while the control itself shows `25:00`. Worth pinning as an explicit spec decision.

**Click behaviour** (`plan.js:1360-1380`): hides the tip, smooth-scrolls the first culpable control into view (`block:"center"`), and flashes **every** culpable control's `.ctl` wrapper with a 1.4 s `ctlFlash` animation (restarted via class-strip + forced reflow). A combo with no named culprits flashes `early`, `late`, and every enabled meal (`comboJumpKinds`, `plan.js:1129-1136`).

### "Prevents N" chips beside the controls (`plan.js:1260-1288`)
Four hidden buttons in the preferences strip (`#blkDayStart`, `#blkDayEnd`, `#blkMealLunch`, `#blkMealDinner`), each shown only when its diagnostics list is non-empty.
- Text: `⚠ Prevents ${n}`.
- `title`: `${label} rules out ${n} show${s}: ${first 8 titles, comma-joined}` + `, +${rest} more` when over 8. Labels: `Your day start`, `Your day end`, `Your lunch break`, `Your dinner break`.
- `aria-label`: the same tip + ` — click to highlight them on the grid`.
- Click → `flashBlockedLanes`: smooth-scrolls `#board` into view (`block:"nearest"`) and flashes each shut-out lane (`plan.js:1405-1416`, `4132-4134`).

Diagnostics semantics (`placementDiagnostics`, `lib/engine.js:675-750`): a show counts as *blocked* when it has ≥1 available performance inside the date window but none survive the day-hours + meal + arrival/departure filter. A control is listed as culpable iff relaxing **only** that control (all others as-is) would rescue at least one performance. So a control's list is exactly "the shows this control shuts out". `dayEndCeil` defaults to 1620 (27:00) — the axis' late edge.

## 7. Availability colours, statuses, and price display

### Status → grid mark class (`segClass`, `plan.js:920-932`)
`soldOut === true` short-circuits to `seg-sold` **before** the status switch.

| Status (uppercased) | Class | Colour |
|---|---|---|
| `TICKETS_AVAILABLE` | `seg-avail` | `#2ac9de` |
| `TWO_FOR_ONE` | `seg-2for1` | 45° weave of `#2ac9de` / `#00bf57` |
| `PREVIEW_SHOW` | `seg-preview` | `#3438ff` |
| `FREE_TICKETED`, `FREE_NON_TICKETED` | `seg-free` | `#00bf57` |
| `EVENT_SPECIFIC` | `seg-event` | `#8c4fd9` |
| `NO_ALLOCATION_CONTACT_VENUE` | `seg-noalloc` | `#ef3934` |
| anything else / null | `seg-avail` if `p.available`, else `seg-sold` | — |
| `soldOut` | `seg-sold` | `#ef3934` — **shares the red "no allocation" mark**; both mean "no online ticket" (`plan.css:704-705`) |

### Status → prose (`statusLabel`, `plan.js:934-946`) — used in the day-mark tip
`sold out` · `tickets available` · `2-for-1` · `preview` · `free (ticketed)` · `free` · `event-specific` · `no allocation — contact venue` · fallback `available` / `unavailable`.

### Status → schedule-block class (`statusSegClass`, `plan.js:2890-2900`)
Same mapping **minus** sold-out handling (a scheduled slot is by definition available); default is `seg-avail`. On the schedule the classes set a `--seg` accent variable instead of a full background, and `seg-2for1` collapses to `--fr-avail` (`plan.css:1240-1245`).

### Price display (`shared/price.js`)
Three-way distinction enforced everywhere: **free** (`priceMin === 0`), **priced** (`priceMin` a number > 0), **unknown** (`priceMin === null`). **Unknown is not free and is not "expensive".**
- `showPrice(show)` reads `priceMin`; falls back to the `free` flag so a pre-price-scrape catalogue still answers £0 (`price.js:36-42`).
- `formatPounds`: whole amounts lose the decimals — `£12`, not `£12.00`; otherwise two decimals (`price.js:54-57`).
- `priceLabel(show)` (`price.js:69-75`):
  - unknown → `Price TBC`
  - 0 → `Free`
  - `max > min` → `£12–£18` (en dash)
  - else → `£12` — the range is shown **only** when the show really has more than one band ("£12–£12" is noise).
- **Search rows suppress unknown prices entirely** rather than printing `Price TBC` — "a search row is no place to advertise a gap in the price cache" (`plan.js:2189-2193`).
- Price caps `[10, 15, 20, 30]`; an active cap **excludes unknown-price shows** — a filter must never claim a show matches on data it doesn't have. `free` is its own bucket, not "≤ £0", because the listing flag identifies it perfectly (`price.js:90-125`, `lib/search.js:121-131`).
- The price ladder is shared with the Now page's `$` chip so the two pages can't quote different money (`plan.js:1864-1867`).

### CSV / ICS status vocabulary
- CSV `Status` column: `Free (non-ticketed)` or `Ticketed` (`lib/itinerary.js:70`).
- ICS `DESCRIPTION` parts: genre, then `Free — non-ticketed` when applicable, then the URL, then `Planned with EdFringeNow` (`lib/itinerary.js:199-203`).

### Preferences also settable by direct manipulation on the schedule
Day hours and meal breaks are editable by dragging the lines/bands on the schedule graphic (§9). Arrival and departure blocks have **no static inputs at all** — they exist only as draggable furniture (`plan.js:590-592`).

### Preference persistence (`plan.js:471-588`)
Stored: `d0, d1, dayStartMin, dayEndMin, mode, meals[{id,enabled,startMin,endMin}], arrival, departure, forced (entries), pacing{gap,max,min}`. On restore each field is validated and clamped against the same bounds its control enforces; anything missing / malformed / out of range leaves that one preference at its default rather than failing the whole restore. `d1` restores **before** `d0` so a stored window can never come back inverted. Meals are matched **by id**, not position. Pacing controls restore by writing back into the DOM, and revert to the markup default if the option no longer exists.

## 9. Schedule graphic (`#schedule` inside `#scheduleWrap`)

### Axis
- Fixed festival axis **09:00 → 27:00 (03:00)**: `AXIS_TOP_MIN = 540`, `AXIS_BOTTOM_MIN = 1620`, `DAY_END_CEIL = 1620` (`plan.js:83-85`).
- The axis only ever **grows** past that span — never shrinks — to hold an unusually early day start, a late day end, an enabled meal band, or a show running into the small hours (`plan.js:2997-3018`).
- Hour height `SCH_HOUR_PX = 34`; head `SCH_HEAD_PX = 46`; left gutter `SCH_GUTTER_PX = 52` (`plan.js:2857-2871`).
- Left gutter labels: `${pad2(h)}:00` for every hour; hours ≥24 get class `sch-hour--late` and **keep counting** (`24:00`, `25:00`, `26:00`, `27:00`) so the same festival night reads as one continuous evening (`plan.js:3026-3041`).

### Day columns
- **Every day in the window is drawn**, not just the ones with shows — drawing only full days made a plan look denser than it was (`plan.js:3045-3061`). A scheduled day that falls outside the current window is appended rather than silently vanishing.
- A day earns a **full column** when it has ≥1 show, or when it is the arrival/departure boundary day with its trip block enabled. Everything else collapses to `SCH_EMPTY_COL_PX = 30` with class `sch-day--empty` (`plan.js:3066-3069`).
- Weekend columns get class `wknd` (`plan.js:3090`).
- Head, full column: `<div class="sch-dow">${DOW_LONG[dow]} <span class="sch-date">${dayNum} Aug</span></div>` + `<div class="sch-day-count">${n} show${n===1?"":"s"}</div>` where `DOW_LONG = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"]` (`plan.js:2873`, `3097-3099`).
- Head, collapsed column: just the day number in `.sch-dow--empty`; the column carries `title="${DOW_LONG} ${dayNum} Aug — nothing planned"` (`plan.js:3100-3101`).
- Width breakpoints on the host: `cols-narrow` when the flexed column width < 78px (drops the tiny start–end time), `cols-tiny` when < 56px (also drops the genre emoji, so the title always wins the space) (`plan.js:3080-3081`).

### Show blocks (`a.sch-show`, `buildScheduleBlock`, `plan.js:3314-3347`)
- It is an **`<a href>`** to the edfringe.com page (`target="_blank" rel="noopener" draggable="false"`), so right-click / middle-click / long-press "open link" works natively. A **plain left-click is intercepted** to pin the performance instead (`plan.js:3949-3962`).
- Classes: `sch-show` + `statusSegClass(status)` + `sch-show--pinned` when forced.
- Minimum height `SCH_MIN_BLOCK = 34px`; adds `sch-show--tight` below `SCH_TIGHT_PX = 42px`, which drops the start–end time and clamps the title to one line — the axis beside the block already says when it is, and the venue is the fact you can't get anywhere else (`plan.js:2859-2865, 3329`).
- Contents: optional `.sch-pin` `🔒`, `.sch-emoji` genre emoji, `.sch-name` title, `.sch-meta` containing `.sch-time` `${startTime}–${slotEndTime}` and `.sch-venue` (`venueName || venueCode`, omitted when blank).
- **No native `title`** — the rich hover card carries all of it.

**Genre emoji** (`GENRE_EMOJI`, `plan.js:108-122`): Comedy 😂 · Theatre 🎭 · Cabaret and Variety 🎪 · Children's Shows 🧸 · Dance, Physical Theatre & Circus 💃 · Events ✨ · Exhibitions 🖼️ · Music 🎵 · Musicals and Opera 🎶 · Spoken Word 🗣️ · **fallback 🎟️**.

### Travel legs (`.sch-leg`, `buildTravelLeg`, `plan.js:3350-3400`)
Drawn **only** between consecutive same-day shows whose gap is `0 ≤ gap < 60` minutes (`plan.js:3108-3113`).

| Case | `.leg-text` | `title` |
|---|---|---|
| Same venue code | `same venue · ${gap}′ gap` | `${venueName \|\| "Same venue"} — no travel, ${gap} min between shows` |
| Coordinates unknown | `nearby · ${gap}′ gap` | `Travel time unknown (venue has no coordinates)` |
| Known | `${round(mins)}′ · ${km.toFixed(1)}km · ${spare}` where spare = `+N′` or `-N′` | `${modeEmoji} ${mins} min ${verb} · ${km} km from ${A} to ${B} — ${gap} min gap, ${spare} min spare` |

`MODE_META` verbs: walk → `walk`, bike → `by bike`, car → `by car` (`plan.js:125-129`). Primes rather than "min" so three facts fit the line; the signed slack goes unlabelled in the pill because spelling out "spare" pushed the line past the pill in a normal-width column (`plan.js:3386-3394`). `.leg-emoji` carries the current mode's emoji.

### Draggable overlay (`.sch-overlay`, `buildScheduleOverlay`, `plan.js:3404-3449`)
- Two shaded `.sch-zone` regions: "before day starts" (top) and "after day ends" (bottom), each with a themed emoji scatter.
- **Boundary inset**: the day-start line + top zone skip the first column when the arrival block is enabled; the day-end line + bottom zone skip the last column when departure is enabled — the trip blocks own those edges instead (`plan.js:3416-3417, 3444-3446`).
- **Day lines** (`.sch-dayline--start` / `--end`): `.dl-grip` + `.dl-flag` reading `Day starts ${HH:MM}` / `Day ends ${clock}`. The end uses the **extended** clock (`25:00`), the start the plain one (`plan.js:3451-3466`). Live label rewrite during drag (`plan.js:3809-3818`).
- **Meal bands** (`.sch-meal`, enabled only): min height 6px; centre label `${HH:MM}–${HH:MM} · 🍽 ${Name}` (e.g. `12:30–13:30 · 🍽 Lunch`), plus `.meal-resize--top` / `--bottom` grips (`plan.js:3594-3615`).
- **Conflict triangle on board labels** (`exclMarkHTML`, `plan.js:3588-3592`): `<span class="excl-mark" data-excl="…" aria-label="excludes ${n} show${s}">▲</span>` — the same red triangle the lane pills use, so "conflict" reads the same on day lines, meal bands and trip blocks as it does on the grid. Rendered only when the list is non-empty.

### Drag mechanics
| Target | Bounds | On release |
|---|---|---|
| Day-start line | `clamp(min, 0, effectiveDayEnd()-15)` | `refresh()` |
| Day-end line | `clamp(min, dayStartMin+15, 1620)` | `refresh()` |
| Meal band top grip | `clamp(min, 0, endMin-10)` | `refresh()` |
| Meal band bottom grip | `clamp(min, startMin+10, 1440)` | `refresh()` |
| Meal band body (move) | keeps length; `clamp(s0+Δ, 0, 1440-len)` | `refresh()` |
| Arrival block lower edge | `clamp(min, axisTop, effectiveDayEnd())` | `refresh()` |
| Departure block upper edge | `clamp(min, dayStartMin, axisBottom)` | `refresh()` |

All snap to **5-minute** increments (`minuteFromClientY`, `plan.js:3783-3790`). During a drag only the overlay repositions live (`repositionOverlayLive`, `plan.js:3794-3835`) — the full re-plan happens on pointer release. Time inputs in the preferences strip are synced live during the drag (`syncDayInputs` / `syncMealInputs`). Sources: `plan.js:3742-3780, 3837-3903`.

### Trip blocks (`buildTripBlock`, `plan.js:3706-3740`)
Rendered **inside their own day column body**, behind the shows, so they stay on that one day.
- Arrival: `title="Getting there — drag the lower edge; no shows are placed before this on your first day"`; label `🚆 Arrive ${HH:MM}` (default 11:00).
- Departure: `title="Getting out — drag the upper edge; no shows are placed after this on your last day"`; label `🧳 Leave ${extended clock}` (default 22:00).
- Both default `enabled: true` (`plan.js:209-210`).
- Both carry the `▲` exclusion triangle when the block alone shuts shows out.

### Partner nags (`plan.js:3617-3701`, `shared/affiliates.js`)
Two kinds, each a small pill inside a region that already exists:

| Kind | Emoji | Question | Where | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sleep` | 🛏️ | `Need a place to sleep?` | the "after day ends" night zone | `stayLink()` → text `Find a bed`, partner `Booking.com`, Booking search for Edinburgh with the trip's own check-in (`d0`) / check-out (`d1`) |
| `travel` | 🎟️ | `Transportation sorted?` | **both** trip blocks (arrival and departure) | `travelLink()` → text `Trains, coaches & flights`, partner `Omio`, `https://www.omio.com/travel/edinburgh` |

- CTA `title`: `${question} ${text} on ${partner} — partner link, we may earn a commission`.
- `rel="sponsored noopener noreferrer"`, `target="_blank"`.
- Close button `.nag-x`: text `×`, `aria-label="Hide the “${question}” suggestion"`. Click is `preventDefault`+`stopPropagation` so it doesn't reach the draggable furniture underneath. Dismissal removes **every** copy of that nag and persists with no TTL (`plan.js:3670-3701`).
- A region shorter than `NAG_MIN_PX = 30` simply omits the nag; a drag that squeezes the region hides it live and dropping the drag rebuilds it (`plan.js:3642-3693`).
- Checkout guard: a checkout not after check-in becomes the next morning, so a one-day window doesn't ask Booking.com for a zero-night stay (`affiliates.js:74-92`).
- Affiliate IDs ship empty by default — every link works as a plain untagged deep link (`affiliates.js:37-49`).

### Exclusion popup (`#exclPop`, `wireExcludePopup`, `plan.js:3971-4013`)
Cursor-following popup, delegated over `#schedule` for any `[data-excl]` target.
- `.excl-pop-head`: `Excludes ${n} show${n===1?"":"s"}`.
- `.excl-pop-list`: up to **14** titles, one `<li>` each.
- `.excl-pop-more`: `+${more} more` when over 14.
- Hidden on pointer-leave and on `#scheduleWrap` scroll.

### Show hover card (`#schedCard`, `fillShowCard`, `plan.js:4032-4048`)
Cursor-following, flipped left/up when it would overflow, clamped ≥8px inside the viewport.
- `.card-img` — `<img loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.parentNode.remove()">`, omitted when the slot has no image.
- `.card-genre` — `${genreEmoji} ${genre || "Show"}`.
- `.card-title`, `.card-meta` — `${startTime}–${endTime}` + optional ` · ${venueName · room}`.
- `.card-blurb` — first **220** chars + `…` when truncated; omitted when blank.
- `.card-hint` — `Click to lock into your plan 🔒 · right-click to open edfringe.com ↗`.
- Hidden on pointer-move off a block, pointer-leave, and `#scheduleWrap` scroll.

### Ambient emoji decor (`DECOR_SETS`, `plan.js:3473-3576`)
Faint emoji scatters behind each "you can't be here" region, themed to what the region is: `food` behind meal bands (48 emoji), `morning` behind the pre-day-start zone (22), `night` behind the post-day-end zone (20), `travel` behind the trip blocks (20). Laid on a fixed **43px** cell grid (≈5 emoji per square inch), positioned/sized/rotated/faded by a deterministic hash of cell index + region seed — so it stays put across re-plans and a resize only *appends*. Cached by `set:seed:width/16:height/16`. Only visible while the pointer is over the board (`is-grid-hover` on the host) and never on touch (`plan.js:3922-3927`).

### Re-plan animation (`plan.js:3152-3308`)
Diffs against a snapshot of the previous board:
- Same show, new position → **FLIP move** (`sch-show--moving`).
- New show in an existing day → **arrival** (`sch-show--enter`, staggered `min(i*26, 180)ms`).
- New show in a brand-new column → rides that column's entrance instead (no double motion).
- Whole new day column → `sch-day--enter`.
- Surviving column whose width changed → flex-basis tween over `0.32s ease`, with a 600 ms safety timeout so an interrupted render can't strand a column at a fixed width.
- Departed show → a **ghost** clone fades out where it sat (`sch-ghost`).
- **Skipped entirely** while scrubbing the date window (`animate: false`) and under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

### `#planSummary` (`role="status" aria-live="polite"`)

- Otherwise: `Planned ` + `<b>${scheduledShows} of ${matchedShows} shows</b>` + ` across ${days} day${days===1?"":"s"} (${d0}–${d1} Aug).` One sentence and nothing after it — the old "3 forced in · by walk" tail restated things the page already shows (`plan.js:2965-2970`).

`Nothing could be scheduled in this window. Try widening your dates, raising the per-day maximum, shortening the gap, or relaxing your day hours / meal breaks.` (`index.html:504-507`, `plan.js:2988-2992`)

### `.plan-actions`
- `#downloadCsvBtn`: download-arrow SVG + `Download itinerary` + `<span class="btn-ext">CSV</span>`. Writes `fringe-itinerary.csv`, **UTF-8 BOM-prefixed**, MIME `text/csv;charset=utf-8` (`index.html:511-516`, `plan.js:4152-4155`).
- `#importIcsBtn`: calendar SVG + `Import to calendar` + `<span class="btn-ext">ICS</span>`. Writes `fringe-plan.ics`, MIME `text/calendar;charset=utf-8`, `calendarName = "Fringe 2026 · ${d0}–${d1} Aug"` (`index.html:517-522`, `plan.js:4156-4172`).
- Both buttons are `disabled` whenever `schedule.scheduled.length === 0` (`plan.js:1046-1048`).
- `.plan-actions-note`: `Both files are built here in your browser — nothing is uploaded.` (`index.html:523`)

**CSV shape** (`lib/itinerary.js:45-78`): headers `Date, Day, Start, End, Show, Genre, Venue, Room, Status, Tickets`; CRLF line endings; RFC-4180 escaping; `Day` is a 3-letter weekday.

**ICS shape** (`lib/itinerary.js:130-236`): `VERSION:2.0`, `PRODID:-//EdFringeNow//Fringe Planner//EN`, `METHOD:PUBLISH`, `X-WR-CALNAME`, `X-WR-TIMEZONE:Europe/London`, an embedded `VTIMEZONE` with the standing UK BST/GMT rules (so a visitor whose calendar is set to New York doesn't get the plan five hours out), `DTSTART/DTEND;TZID=Europe/London`, a **stable UID** `${slug}-${localStamp}@edfringenow.com` so re-importing an edited plan updates events instead of duplicating them, `GEO` when venue coordinates exist, `URL`, and a **30-minute** `VALARM` reminder by default. Lines folded to ≤75 UTF-8 octets.

### ICS how-to (`#icsHowto`, revealed after the first .ics download and smooth-scrolled into view)
- Close button `#icsHowtoClose`: `×`, `aria-label="Hide these instructions"`, `title="Hide"`.
- `.ics-howto-title`: `Downloaded — now into Google Calendar`
- Step 1: `In Google Calendar, create a calendar called **Fringe 2026** (Settings → Add calendar → Create new calendar).`
- Step 2: `Open [Settings → Import & export](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/r/settings/export), choose **fringe-plan.ics**, and set the destination to **Fringe 2026**.`
- `.ics-howto-note`: `Its own calendar means you can hide or delete the whole plan in one click. Change your plan later and re-import: the events update in place rather than doubling up. Times are pinned to Edinburgh (Europe/London), so they stay right wherever your calendar lives.`

Source: `index.html:531-548`, `plan.js:4169-4175`.

---

## 11. Time semantics

1. **Fringe day boundary = 06:00.** `FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES = 360`. The day named `2026-08-14` runs 06:00 on the 14th to 06:00 on the 15th. 06:00 is the seam because the catalogue has nothing at all between 00:30 and 06:00, so the join falls where nobody is looking. Half-open: a 06:00 show belongs to the morning it happens in, not the night before (`shared/fringe-day.js:33-42`).
2. **One boundary, defined once.** The scraper buckets day files by it, the Now page picks its day file and its "now" by it, the time wheel stops at it, and the planner folds its late shows by it — `NIGHT_FOLD_CUTOFF_MIN = FRINGE_DAY_START_MINUTES` (`shared/fringe-day.js:22-30`, `lib/engine.js:159`).
3. **Night fold.** A performance starting before 06:00 is re-dated to the **previous** calendar day and its minute-of-day gains 1440 (00:45 → 24:45). Real wall-clock start/end and real date are preserved on the slot (`realDate`) for exports and chronological ordering (`lib/engine.js:176-181`, `269-291`).
4. **Window membership is by festival date** when date bounds are given — so a Friday 00:45 late show counts as Friday night, and a show on the morning after the last day does not leak in (`lib/engine.js:254, 270-272`).
5. **Extended clock strings.** `"24:30"` is the stored form (keeps every string comparison, sort and lookup key correctly ordered); only the display layer wraps it back to `"00:30"` via `clockHHMM` / `hourLabel` (`shared/fringe-day.js:16-20, 50-70`). In the planner: `minToDayClock` (`plan.js:152-155`) prints the extended form and is used for the day-end input, the day-end line flag and the departure label; `minToHHMM` (`plan.js:143-146`) caps at 23:59 and is used for the day-start input, meal times and the arrival label; `hhmm` (`plan.js:1293-1295`) wraps mod-24 and is used **inside conflict tips**.
6. **The schedule axis is 09:00–27:00 (03:00)** and the day-end control may be set as late as 27:00 — a Fringe evening runs past midnight, and a native `<time>` input can't express that (`plan.js:80-85`, `index.html:406-419`).
7. **Default day hours 09:00 – 25:00 (01:00)** so ordinary late-night shows are catchable out of the box (`plan.js:87-90`).
8. **Wall-clock, not instants.** `dateTimeToMinutes` uses `Date.UTC` deliberately — a pure wall-clock minute count with no timezone conversion, because shows.json stores local Edinburgh wall-clock times and every performance/filter in the app uses the same convention (`lib/availability.js:73-79`). `itinerary.js` reads them back with `getUTC*` accessors to recover the original Edinburgh wall-clock with no drift (`itinerary.js:10-29`).
9. **Duration is derived**, not shipped: `end = start + show.duration`; when duration is absent `end === start` (`lib/availability.js:114-117`, `lib/engine.js:264`).
10. **Default trip window**: Aug 7 → Aug 24 (18 days), which is why `#railLen`'s markup placeholder reads `18 days` (`plan.js:77-78`, `index.html:135`).

---

## 12. Empty / edge states, and everything else user-visible

| State | Behaviour | Source |
|---|---|---|
| No favourites at all | `#intakeStage` visible; `#calWrap`, `#clearFavBtn`, `#legendBtn`, `#planPanel` hidden; `#lanes` emptied; `#boardCount` reads `No shows planned, no shows selected` | `plan.js:811-821` |
| Empty board + a preference change | `refresh()` still fires `schedulePrefsSave()` **before** the empty-board bail — controls are preferences in their own right | `plan.js:1002-1007` |
| Legend on an empty board | Force-closed; `#calLegend` stays `hidden` regardless of `legendOpen` while `#calWrap` is hidden | `plan.js:429-431`, `814` |
| Removing the last lane | Falls through to the full `clearFavourites()` reset | `plan.js:1738-1741` |
| Search with zero rows | Popup **still opens**, showing only `#ssEmpty` | `plan.js:2127, 2136` |
| Catalogue still loading when the user types | `runSearch` returns early; the input just holds the text | `plan.js:2085` |
| Availability sidecar failed | Every performance is status-unknown; `segClass` falls back to `seg-avail`/`seg-sold` on the `available` boolean; `isAvailable` returns **false** for a blank status, so an availability-less catalogue schedules nothing | `plan.js:272-275`, `hydrate.js:80-96`, `availability.js:43-49` |
| Descriptions sidecar failed | Logged, never surfaced; hover cards and search fall back to the catalogue blurb | `plan.js:308-321` |
| localStorage unavailable / private mode | Every read/write is try/caught; failures `console.warn` and fall through to defaults — nothing is surfaced | `plan.js:349-415, 524-531` |
| Data-cache warnings | `noteCache` logs to console only: "in both cases the caller still got its data" | `plan.js:294-299` |
| Day column with 0 shows in the window | Collapsed 30px sliver, day number only, `title="… — nothing planned"` | `plan.js:3100-3101` |
| Meal band dragged to <6px | Height floored at 6px | `plan.js:3598` |
| Show block shorter than 34px | Height floored at `SCH_MIN_BLOCK` | `plan.js:3315` |
| Reduced motion | Disables: date-window glide, board diff animation, gold mark sheen, gold lock-in swell | `plan.js:1554, 2985`, `plan.css:676-681` |
| Grid vs. engine day disagreement (**edge worth spec'ing**) | `buildDayCells` buckets marks by the **raw** `p.date` (`plan.js:951-955`), while the engine schedules by **festival** date. A 00:45 performance on 15 Aug therefore draws in the grid's column for the 15th but is planned onto the night of the 14th, and its `seg--selected` gold will not line up with the schedule column it appears in. | `plan.js:948-987` vs `lib/engine.js:269-275` |
| Engine `unscheduled` reason strings | Computed on every plan but **never rendered** — reachable only via the debug JSON | `lib/engine.js:625-630`, `plan.js:2548` |
| Conflict-tip clock wrapping | Conflict tips print a 25:00 day end as `01:00` (`hhmm` wraps mod 24) while the control shows `25:00` | `plan.js:1293-1302, 1339-1341` |

### Cursors
Custom `--lock-cursor` (padlock) on `.lane-label` and `--unlock-cursor` on `.lane--forced .lane-label` and `.cell--pin`, carrying the pin/unpin affordance without a tooltip (`plan.css:614, 620`).

content.text: Now the core deliverable — the executable requirements document. This is long but it's the spine everything else keys on.

input.content:
# EdFringeNow — executable UI/UX requirements

The **specific, testable requirements** for the site's two front-ends — what each
surface must render and how it must behave, down to exact strings, states and
semantics. Part I is the **Now** page (`index.html`, the spontaneity tool);
Part II is the **Plan** page (`plan/`, the festival planner). The feature-level
story of what the product is and why lives in
[docs/product-spec.md](docs/product-spec.md); this document holds only
statements a test can prove.

Every leaf below is executed by exactly one case under
[product/requirements/](requirements/) — see its
[README](requirements/README.md) for the framework: kinds, runners, goldens,
the coverage gate, and how to add or change a requirement. The committed
golden images and coded assertions are the **owner's approval record**: an
agent may propose a new expected, but never changes a committed one to make a
red case pass — on a mismatch it surfaces actual vs expected and asks.

> # ⚠️ A GREEN BUILD MEANS "CLAIMED", NOT "FULLY VERIFIED" ⚠️
>
> Every leaf is claimed by one case of the right kind, and the visual cases
> render the real pages in a real (headless, pinned) Chromium. What the harness
> cannot reach, stated plainly:
>
> - **The network is faked.** Leaflet, fonts, map tiles, the geocoder and the
>   show data are served from committed fixtures — cases prove our code *asks*
>   correctly (the exact URL, the exact request), not that OpenStreetMap,
>   Nominatim or edfringe.com answer.
> - **External links are asserted as URLs**, never followed: a case proves the
>   buy link targets `edfringe.com/tickets/whats-on/<slug>`, not that the shop
>   exists.
> - **Real geolocation, a real GPS fix, and a real device clock** are outside
>   the harness: cases substitute fixed fakes and prove the app's *response* to
>   each outcome.
> - **Downloads are read back as bytes** (CSV/ICS content), not imported into a
>   real calendar.
>
> The fixture dataset is a frozen, curated snapshot of the real committed data
> — see [shared/fixtures/build-fixtures.js](requirements/shared/fixtures/build-fixtures.js)
> for its provenance and the two documented adjustments in it.

**Numbering.** Every leaf carries a stable id (e.g. `6.4`). Add new
requirements under new numbers; never renumber or reuse a retired one. Each
leaf has exactly one case named `<slug>.<id>.case.js`; the case's *kind* is the
folder it lives in (`screen/` — a pixel-exact golden of the rendered page;
`behavior/` — a driven gesture asserted in code; `logic/` — a pure rule proved
against the shipped module). The line under each leaf tagged
`req-gallery` is machine-managed (the gallery generator rewrites it); the prose
is hand-authored.

**The reference moment.** Visual cases render at **Sat 15 Aug 2026, 19:30**
Edinburgh time, from a fixed fake location in central Edinburgh, against the
frozen fixture dataset ([shared/reference-now.js](requirements/shared/reference-now.js)).

---

# Part I — the Now page

## 1. Page chrome

- `1.1` At desktop width the header shows the **EdFringeNow** logo, a centred **Now | Plan** nav with **Now** active (red, underlined), and a **Use my location** button on the right.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-chrome.1.1](requirements/screen/cases/now-chrome.1.1.png) <!-- req-gallery:1.1 -->

  The logo reads `EdFringe` + red `Now`; the nav links are `Now` (`./`, active) and `Plan` (`plan/`); the location button carries `aria-label="Use my location"`. Header is sticky, white, 64px.
  </details>

- `1.2` Below 860px the **Now | Plan** nav is hidden — the mobile header is logo + location button only.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-chrome.1.2](requirements/screen/cases/now-chrome.1.2.png) <!-- req-gallery:1.2 -->

  Golden renders the whole resting page at the 390px reference viewport: no nav links between the logo and the location button.
  </details>

- `1.3` The footer carries the tagline **"Helping you navigate the chaos and catch another show!"**, the **© 2026 Missing Bulb** line, the commission disclosure, and the **Contact Us / Privacy Policy / Accessibility / Terms of Use** links.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-chrome.1.3](requirements/screen/cases/now-chrome.1.3.png) <!-- req-gallery:1.3 -->

  Disclosure text: `Booking links on plans (tables, trains, stays, tours) may earn us a small commission, at no extra cost to you.` Quick Links column: `Contact Us` (mailto:support@edfringenow.com), `Privacy Policy`; Legal column: `Accessibility`, `Terms of Use`.
  </details>

- `1.4` The site version is reachable by anyone: the footer's **© 2026 Missing Bulb** line carries tooltip **"EdFringeNow v\<version\>"** read from `package.json`.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:1.4 -->

  `#footerVersion`'s `title` attribute equals `EdFringeNow v` + the version served by `package.json`.
  </details>

- `1.5` The **debug pill** never shows for a visitor whose location is in the UK or unknown; it appears (reading `debug v<version>`, with the simulated-now and move-location tools) only when geolocation reports a position **outside** the UK.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:1.5 -->

  In-UK fix → `#debugMenu` stays `hidden` and the app adopts the real clock. Out-of-UK fix → pill visible, app keeps its simulated clock, and `#debugNowText` reads the simulated moment (`Fri 14 Aug, 15:44 BST`).
  </details>

## 2. First-run explainer

- `2.1` A first-time visitor sees the explainer: kicker **"3,800 shows. One free hour."**, title **"See what you can actually get to — right now."**, the three numbered steps, and the **"Got it — let's go"** button.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-intro.2.1](requirements/screen/cases/now-intro.2.1.png) <!-- req-gallery:2.1 -->

  Steps, verbatim: **Say when you next have to be somewhere.** A show, dinner, a train. / **We work out how far that leaves you.** On foot, bike, bus or taxi. / **Pick something you can make** — and still get to your next thing.
  </details>

- `2.2` Dismissing the explainer (✕ or **Got it — let's go**) hides it, and it stays hidden on every later visit.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:2.2 -->

  After dismissal `#intro` is hidden and a reload of the page never shows it again (remembered in `localStorage`, independent of the settings snapshot).
  </details>

## 3. The next-commitment card

- `3.1` With no commitment set, the card shows a faded skeleton of the plan-to-be ("Your plan" / "You are here" / "Your next commitment") under a **"Tap to set constraints"** trigger.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-commitment.3.1](requirements/screen/cases/now-commitment.3.1.png) <!-- req-gallery:3.1 -->
  </details>

- `3.2` Opening the card shows **"Your next commitment \<date\>"** with the time wheels preset to now + 2 hours, a live count of shows starting then, the any-genre pick list, and the **"Not a show? Type a place"** input with a disabled **🔎 Find on map** button.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-commitment.3.2](requirements/screen/cases/now-commitment.3.2.png) <!-- req-gallery:3.2 -->

  At the reference moment the wheels read `21:30` and the count line reads `2` `shows start at 21:30`; each pick row shows radio, title, venue, genre` · `price. The Find button is disabled while the place input is empty.
  </details>

- `3.3` A chosen minute at which nothing starts reads **"No shows start exactly then. Nearest:"** with up to four **"HH:MM · n"** suggestion buttons.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-commitment.3.3](requirements/screen/cases/now-commitment.3.3.png) <!-- req-gallery:3.3 -->
  </details>

- `3.4` Picking a show commits it: the intake card disappears, the plan strip renders, and every open panel closes.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:3.4 -->

  After clicking a `.show-pick` row: `body.has-plan` set, `#journeyStrip` populated, `#constraintPanel` hidden.
  </details>

- `3.5` Finding a typed place lists the matches under **"Which one?"** with a kind icon per hit, keeps only results around Edinburgh, and always ends with a **"Keep "\<q\>" as a note"** row.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-commitment.3.5](requirements/screen/cases/now-commitment.3.5.png) <!-- req-gallery:3.5 -->

  The fixture geocoder answers three hits; the out-of-Edinburgh one is dropped, so the list shows 🍽️ The Witchery by the Castle and 🚆 Edinburgh Waverley, then the 📝 note row.
  </details>

- `3.6` When the geocoder can't be reached the card says **"Map search isn't reachable right now."** — the only user-facing error string on the page.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-commitment.3.6](requirements/screen/cases/now-commitment.3.6.png) <!-- req-gallery:3.6 -->
  </details>

- `3.7` The time wheel offers 5-minute steps from the current minute to 29:55 (the 06:00 fringe-day end), opens at now + 120 minutes snapped to 5, and displays hours past midnight as 00–05.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🔧 _Logic leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:3.7 -->

  Proved against `js/constraint-time.js`: `defaultConstraintTime`, `earliestWheelMinutes`, `minutesForHour`, `WHEEL_MINUTES`, and `hourLabel`'s 24→00 wrap.
  </details>

## 4. The plan strip

- `4.1` A committed destination renders the plan: **"Your plan"** with an **Open in Maps** link, the origin node (**"You are here"**, current time, travel mode), a **"🚶 N min walk"** leg, and the destination node subtitled **"Your next commitment"**.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-plan-strip.4.1](requirements/screen/cases/now-plan-strip.4.1.png) <!-- req-gallery:4.1 -->

  Leg minutes are never shown below 1. Each of the stop/destination nodes carries `Change ▾` and `×` controls.
  </details>

- `4.2` With spare time before the commitment and shows that fit, the strip offers **"You have \<duration\> to spare — want to see a show? \<n\> fit below"**, dismissible with ✕.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-plan-strip.4.2](requirements/screen/cases/now-plan-strip.4.2.png) <!-- req-gallery:4.2 -->

  "fits" when n = 1, "fit" otherwise; the link smooth-scrolls to the list.
  </details>

- `4.3` A show slipped into the plan renders as a stop node: time range, title, venue · genre, a slack chip **"\<duration\> to spare"**, and the **"🎟 Buy ahead · skip the queue"** link.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-plan-strip.4.3](requirements/screen/cases/now-plan-strip.4.3.png) <!-- req-gallery:4.3 -->

  A free show renders no buy link; a sold-out one renders a `Sold out` pill instead (see `6.4` for the list-side stamp).
  </details>

- `4.4` A selected show that would make you late for the commitment wears the **"You'll be late"** chip.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-plan-strip.4.4](requirements/screen/cases/now-plan-strip.4.4.png) <!-- req-gallery:4.4 -->
  </details>

- `4.5` The buy-ahead link opens **`https://www.edfringe.com/tickets/whats-on/<slug>`** in a new tab.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:4.5 -->

  `href` equals the pattern with the show's own slug; `target="_blank"`, `rel` includes `noopener`.
  </details>

- `4.6` **Open in Maps** builds a Google Maps directions URL from the user's location to the commitment, in the chosen travel mode, adding the slipped-in show as a waypoint.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:4.6 -->

  `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=<lat,lng>&destination=<lat,lng>&travelmode=walking|driving|bicycling` + `&waypoints=` when a leg show is set.
  </details>

- `4.7` The ✕ on the destination clears the commitment but keeps a selected show; the ✕ on the stop clears just the selected show.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🚩 _Behavior leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:4.7 -->
  </details>

- `4.8` Durations are phrased for humans: minutes under an hour, **"1 hour and 20 minutes"** up to two hours, **"about 2½ hours"** beyond.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & proof</summary>

  🔧 _Logic leaf._ <!-- req-gallery:4.8 -->

  `shared/duration.js` `friendlyDuration`: `<60` → `45 minutes`; exact hours → `1 hour`/`2 hours`; 60–120 → `1 hour and 20 minutes`; `>120` → `about 2½ hours` (nearest half hour); negative/non-finite → empty.
  </details>

## 5. Filters

- `5.1` The genre panel asks **"Which genres?"** with an **everything!** escape hatch and the ten festival genres, each with its emoji and a grey count of what ticking it would leave.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-filters.5.1](requirements/screen/cases/now-filters.5.1.png) <!-- req-gallery:5.1 -->

  The ten genres, in order: Cabaret and Variety, Children's Shows, Comedy, Dance, Physical Theatre & Circus, Events, Exhibitions, Music, Musicals and Opera, Spoken Word, Theatre. A zero-count row fades. Counts are measured with every filter applied *except* the panel's own.
  </details>

- `5.2` The subgenre panel asks **"Which subgenres?"** offering only the subgenres present in what the other filters leave, with counts; when nothing is left it says **"No subgenres in what's left — widen your genres."**

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-filters.5.2](requirements/screen/cases/now-filters.5.2.png) <!-- req-gallery:5.2 -->
  </details>

- `5.3` The price panel says **"Cheapest ticket, up to:"** over the shared six-step ladder — **Any / Free / £10 / £15 / £20 / £30** — each with a count.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

  ![now-filters.5.3](requirements/screen/cases/now-filters.5.3.png) <!-- req-gallery:5.3 -->
  </details>

- `5.4` The travel panel asks **"How are you getting there?"** with Walking (3.3 km/h), Taxi/Car (30 km/h), Bicycle (15 km/h) and a 1–60 minute slider reading **"N min max"**.

  <details><summary>Acceptance & golden</summary>

# EdFringeNow — executable UI/UX requirements

The **specific, testable requirements** for the site's two front-ends — what each
surface must render and how it must behave, down to exact strings, states and
semantics. Part I is the **Now** page (`index.html`, the spontaneity tool);
Part II is the **Plan** page (`plan/`, the festival planner). The feature-level
story of what the product is and why lives in
[docs/product-spec.md](docs/product-spec.md); this document holds only
statements a test can prove.

Every leaf below is executed by exactly one case under
[product/requirements/](requirements/) — see its
[README](requirements/README.md) for the framework: kinds, runners, goldens,
the coverage gate, and how to add or change a requirement. The committed
golden images and coded assertions are the **owner's approval record**: an
agent may propose a new expected, but never changes a committed one to make a
red case pass — on a mismatch it surfaces actual vs expected and asks.

> # ⚠️ A GREEN BUILD MEANS "CLAIMED", NOT "FULLY VERIFIED" ⚠️
>
> Every leaf is claimed by one case of the right kind, and the visual cases
> render the real pages in a real (headless, pinned) Chromium. What the harness
> cannot reach, stated plainly:
>
> - **The network is faked.** Leaflet, fonts, map tiles, the geocoder and the
>   show data are served from committed fixtures — cases prove our code *asks*
>   correctly (the exact URL, the exact request), not that OpenStreetMap,
>   Nominatim or edfringe.com answer.
> - **External links are asserted as URLs**, never followed: a case proves the
>   buy link targets `edfringe.com/tickets/whats-on/<slug>`, not that the shop
>   exists.
> - **Real geolocation, a real GPS fix, and a real device clock** are outside
>   the harness: cases substitute fixed fakes and prove the app's *response* to
>   each outcome.
> - **Downloads are read back as bytes** (CSV/ICS content), not imported into a
>   real calendar.
>
> The fixture dataset is a frozen, curated snapshot of the real committed data
> — see [shared/fixtures/build-fixtures.js](requirements/shared/fixtures/build-fixtures.js)
> for its provenance and the two documented adjustments in it.

**Numbering.** Every leaf carries a stable id (e.g. `6.4`). Add new
requirements under new numbers; never renumber or reuse a retired one. Each
leaf has exactly one case named `<slug>.<id>.case.js`; the case's *kind* is the
folder it lives in (`screen/` — a pixel-exact golden of the rendered page;
`behavior/` — a driven gesture asserted in code; `logic/` — a pure rule proved
against the shipped module). The line under each leaf tagged
`req-gallery` is machine-managed (the gallery generator rewrites it); the prose
is hand-authored.

**The reference moment.** Visual cases render at **Sat 15 Aug 2026, 19:30**
Edinburgh time, from a fixed fake location in central Edinburgh, against the
frozen fixture dataset ([shared/reference-now.js](requirements/shared/reference-now.js)).

---

+

+surface must render and how it must behave, down to exact strings, states and
+semantics. Part I is the **Now** page (`index.html`, the spontaneity tool);
+Part II is the **Plan** page (`plan/`, the festival planner). The feature-level
+story of what the product is and why lives in
+[docs/product-spec.md](docs/product-spec.md); this document holds only
+statements a test can prove.

+Every leaf below is executed by exactly one case under
+[product/requirements/](requirements/) — see its

+the coverage gate, and how to add or change a requirement. The committed
+golden images and coded assertions are the **owner's approval record**: an
+agent may propose a new expected, but never changes a committed one to make a
+red case pass — on a mismatch it surfaces actual vs expected and asks.
